This image is page 32 from a German-language technical manual for a Mercedes-Benz R129, specifically detailing the **Standheizung** (Auxiliary Heating) control unit.

### Component Identification and Controls
The diagram shows a rectangular control panel with several buttons and an LCD display window.

*   **1 (Bottom Left Indicator):** **Kontrollleuchte (gelb)** – Yellow indicator light signaling that a preselected time is active.
*   **2 (Bottom Right Indicator):** **Kontrollleuchte (grün)** – Green indicator light signaling that the auxiliary heating is currently in operation.
*   **3 (Center Display):** **Sichtfenster für Tageszeit und Einschaltzeit** – Viewing window for the time of day and programmed switch-on times.

**Button Functions:**
*   **[ 1 ]:** **Programmheizung – erste vorgewählte Einschaltzeit** – First preselected switch-on time.
*   **[ 2 ]:** **Programmheizung – zweite vorgewählte Einschaltzeit** – Second preselected switch-on time.
*   **[ Clock Icon ]:** **Tageszeit abrufen** – Recall current time of day.
*   **[ Flame Icon ]:** **Sofortheizung** – Immediate heating start/stop.
*   **[ < ] Arrow:** **Tages- und Einschaltzeit verstellen (rücklaufend)** – Decrease time setting.
*   **[ > ] Arrow:** **Tages- und Einschaltzeit verstellen (vorlaufend)** – Increase time setting.

### Technical Descriptions and Warnings
The text explains that the system operates independently of the engine to:
*   Heat the passenger compartment before or during a journey.
*   Defrost the vehicle windows.
*   Pre-warm the engine coolant to facilitate starting in very low temperatures.

**Usage Instructions:**
*   **Sofortheizung (Immediate heating):** Can be switched on manually at any time.
*   **Programmheizung (Programmed heating):** Can be set to start automatically at a specific time.
*   **Hinweis (Note):** To preserve the battery, the heater should only run as long as necessary when the engine is off and should not be cycled multiple times in succession.
*   **Achtung! (Warning!):** The auxiliary heater must not be operated at gas stations or in enclosed spaces without exhaust extraction (e.g., garages).

### Specifications and Markings
*   **Measurements:** Not provided in this document.
*   **Connections/Wire Colors:** Not shown in this user-interface diagram.
*   **Internal Reference Number:** A small code `P22-0012-11A` is visible below the image of the control panel.
*   **Page Number:** 32 (bottom left corner).

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p35_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual (Bedienungsanleitung), specifically page 33, detailing the operation of the auxiliary heating system (Standheizung).

### Visible Text and Sections:

**1. Heading: Vor dem Einschalten (Before switching on)**
*   **Instruction:** Set the temperature selection wheels to the desired interior temperature. The system automatically regulates the temperature to the set value.
*   **Vehicles with automatic heating or air conditioning:** Manually adjust the air volume and air distribution.
*   **Vehicles with automatic climate control:** Air volume and air distribution are controlled automatically.

**2. Heading: Tageszeit abrufen und verstellen (Retrieving and adjusting the time of day)**
*   **Instructions:** Press and hold the button with the **Clock icon**. The current time of day will appear in **Viewing window 3**.
*   **Adjustment:** To correct the time, press the **Clock icon button** and simultaneously press either the **[<] (Left arrow)** or **[>] (Right arrow)** button. A brief press changes the time by **1 minute**.

**3. Heading: Einschaltzeit für Programmheizung einstellen (Setting the switch-on time for programmed heating)**
*   **Memory:** Two switch-on times can be programmed, assigned to **Button 1** and **Button 2**.
*   **Operation:** Press **Button 1** or **Button 2**. The **yellow indicator light 1** will illuminate. **Viewing window 3** will display the number of the button pressed, followed by the programmed switch-on time for approximately **20 seconds**.
*   **Adjustment:** While the switch-on time is being displayed, it can be adjusted by pressing the **[<] (Left arrow)** or **[>] (Right arrow)** buttons.

### Components and Identifiers:
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Clock icon button:** Used for viewing and setting the time of day.
    *   **[<] and [>] icon buttons:** Used for incrementing or decrementing time values.
    *   **Button 1 and Button 2:** Used to select and program two different preset times.
*   **Displays and Indicators:**
    *   **Sichtfenster 3 (Viewing window 3):** The digital display screen for time and program status.
    *   **Kontrolleuchte 1 (Indicator light 1):** A yellow light indicating that a program is active.

### Additional Markings:
*   **Right Margin:** A vertical red bar contains the word "**Bedienung**" (Operation).
*   **Bottom Right:** The page number "**33**" is printed.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p36_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a Mercedes-Benz technical manual (likely for an R129 SL-Class) providing operating instructions for the auxiliary heating system (**Standheizung**). While not a schematic diagram, it details technical operation, component indicators, and maintenance parameters.

### **Components & Indicators Referenced**
*   **Taste 1 & Taste 2 (Buttons 1 & 2):** Program selection buttons for the scheduled heater start.
*   **Taste [Flame symbol] (Heat Button):** Button used for manual "Sofortheizung" (instant heating) or to switch the system off.
*   **Kontrollleuchte 1 (Indicator Light 1):** A **yellow** LED that lights up when a programmed start time is active. It turns off once the heater begins running.
*   **Kontrollleuchte 2 (Indicator Light 2):** A **green** LED that lights up when the heater is actively operating.
*   **Sichtfenster 3 (Display Window 3):** A digital display area showing the programmed start time or the current time of day. It flashes if the operating voltage has been interrupted.

### **Technical Specifications & Measurements**
*   **Maximum Run Time:** 60 minutes.
*   **Activation Delay (Instant Heat):** Approximately 30 seconds after pressing the button.
*   **Temperature Threshold (Instant Heat):** The heater starts if the coolant temperature is below approximately **70 °C**.
*   **Maintenance Requirement:** To ensure proper function, the system should be operated at least **once a month** for approximately **5 minutes** year-round.
*   **Blower Operation:** If the ignition key is removed or in position 0 or 1, the interior blower only activates once a specific coolant temperature has been reached.

### **Visible Text (Translated/Transcribed)**

**Programmheizung einschalten (Switching on programmed heating)**
*   Press Button 1 or 2. Yellow indicator light 1 illuminates. Window 3 shows the time the heater is set to start. Once operating, indicator 1 goes out and green indicator 2 lights up. Max runtime: 60 minutes.

**Sofortheizung einschalten (Switching on instant heating)**
*   Press the [Flame] button. Green indicator 2 lights up. Heating starts after approx. 30 seconds or if coolant temperature is below ~70 °C. Max runtime: 60 minutes.

**Ausschalten (Switching off)**
*   If green indicator 2 is on: Press [Flame] button.
*   If yellow indicator 1 is on: Press button 1 or 2.
*   The system shuts off automatically after a maximum of 60 minutes.

**Hinweise (Notes):**
*   Describes blower behavior based on key position and coolant temperature.
*   Notes that window 3 flashes after power loss, requiring time and program reset.
*   If the green indicator 2 goes out immediately after switching on, a fault is present; repeat the process or visit a Mercedes-Benz service station.
*   Provides the monthly maintenance instruction.

**Page Number:** 34 (visible at bottom left).

This image is a page (page 35) from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual detailing the different types of vehicle keys.

### **General Text (Top Left)**
*   **Heading:** **Fahrzeugschlüssel** (Vehicle keys)
*   **Body Text:** "Zu Ihrem Fahrzeug erhalten Sie" (With your vehicle you receive):
    *   "2 Hauptschlüssel" (2 Master keys)
    *   "1 Nebenschlüssel" (1 Secondary key)
    *   "1 Flachschlüssel" (1 Flat key)
*   **Sub-heading:** **Bei Infrarot-Fernbedienung** (With infrared remote control):
    *   "2 Infrarot-Fernbedienungen mit klappbarem Hauptschlüssel" (2 infrared remote controls with folding master key)
    *   "1 Hauptschlüssel" (1 Master key)
    *   "1 Nebenschlüssel" (1 Secondary key)
    *   "1 Flachschlüssel" (1 Flat key)

---

### **Component Details and Descriptions**

#### **1. Hauptschlüssel (Master Key)**
*   **Illustration:** Shows a key with a silver-colored laser-cut blade and a rectangular black plastic head.
*   **Text:** "Der Hauptschlüssel paßt zu allen Schlössern." (The master key fits all locks.)

#### **2. Nebenschlüssel (Secondary/Valet Key)**
*   **Illustration:** Shows a key with a silver-colored laser-cut blade and a circular black plastic head.
*   **Text:** "Der Nebenschlüssel paßt nur zu den Türschlössern und zum Lenkschloß. Er paßt nicht zu den Schlössern des Kofferraumes, des Handschuhfaches und des Ablagefaches/Brillenfaches in der Armaturenanlage." 
    *   *Translation:* The secondary key fits only the door locks and the steering lock. It does not fit the locks of the trunk, the glove compartment, and the storage compartment/glasses compartment in the dashboard.

#### **3. Flachschlüssel (Flat/Emergency Key)**
*   **Illustration:** Shows a small, thin, all-metal key with a "T" shaped head.
*   **Text:** "Der Flachschlüssel paßt zu allen Schlössern. Wir empfehlen, den Flachschlüssel sicher und für den Bedarfsfall jederzeit erreichbar mitzuführen (zum Beispiel in der Geldbörse)."
    *   *Translation:* The flat key fits all locks. We recommend carrying the flat key safely and accessibly at all times for emergencies (for example, in a wallet).

#### **4. Infrarot-Fernbedienung mit klappbarem Hauptschlüssel (Infrared remote control with folding master key)**
*   **Illustration:** A rectangular electronic key fob with a central round button featuring the Mercedes-Benz star logo. The metal key blade is shown extended.
*   **Text:** "Der Hauptschlüssel paßt zu allen Schlössern. Der Sender befindet sich in der Infrarot-Fernbedienung, die Empfänger neben den Türschlössern und unter dem Kofferraum-Schließzylinder."
    *   *Translation:* The master key fits all locks. The transmitter is located in the infrared remote control; the receivers are located next to the door locks and under the trunk lock cylinder.

---

### **Additional Text and Labels**

*   **Ersatzbeschaffung der Fahrzeugschlüssel** (Procurement of replacement vehicle keys): The text explains that the vehicle uses a special key system, meaning replacements can only be obtained through a Mercedes-Benz Service Station. It notes that losing keys makes the recovery process very time-consuming.
*   **Bedienung** (Operation): Printed vertically on a red tab on the right edge of the page, indicating the manual section.
*   **Page Number:** "35" is visible at the bottom right.

### **Measurements, Connections, and Part Numbers**
*   **Measurements:** No specific dimensions are provided.
*   **Connections:** Mechanical connections are implied between the key blades and the various lock cylinders (doors, ignition, trunk, glovebox). The remote control connects via infrared signal to receivers located at the doors and trunk.
*   **Part Numbers:** No part numbers are visible.
*   **Wire Colors:** None shown; this is a mechanical/functional overview page.

This image is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 SL-Class technical document or owner's manual, specifically page 36, detailing the operation of the central locking system and doors.

### Illustrations

**Left Diagram: Exterior Door Handle**
This grayscale illustration shows the exterior driver-side door handle and lock cylinder.
*   **Number 1:** An arrow indicates pulling the handle outward to open the door.
*   **Number 2:** A curved arrow indicates turning the key counter-clockwise to unlock the vehicle.
*   **Number 3:** A curved arrow indicates turning the key clockwise to lock the vehicle.
*   **Reference Text:** Small text "220" is visible in the lower right corner of the illustration box.

**Right Diagram: Interior Door Panel**
This illustration shows the interior door handle and power seat control module.
*   **Number 4:** A red arrow indicates pulling the interior handle to open the door.
*   **Number 5:** A downward-pointing red arrow on the lock pin indicates locking the door from the inside.
*   **Number 6:** An upward-pointing red arrow on the lock pin indicates unlocking the door from the inside.
*   **Reference Number:** The code "P-8-311-6144" is printed in the lower right corner of the illustration.

---

### Text Content (German)

**Zentralverriegelung**
Das Fahrzeug kann an den Türen oder am Kofferraumdeckel zentral ver- oder entriegelt werden. In die Zentralverriegelung ist auch die Tankklappe einbezogen.

**Türen**
1. **Öffnen - Griff ziehen**
2. **Entriegeln**
3. **Verriegeln**
4. **Öffnen - Griff ziehen**
5. **Verriegeln**
6. **Entriegeln**

**Hinweise:**
*   An der Beifahrertür kann nur dann zentral ver- oder entriegelt werden, wenn der Schlüssel aus dem Lenkschloß abgezogen ist oder wenn er nach dem Abziehen wieder eingesteckt, jedoch nicht nach rechts gedreht wurde.
*   Ist das Schloß einer Tür nicht richtig eingerastet, die Tür öffnen und richtig schließen.
*   Von innen entriegeln: Türen, Kofferraum und Tankklappe werden entriegelt, wenn vorher von innen verriegelt wurde. Wurde vorher von außen verriegelt, wird nur die betreffende Tür entriegelt. Kofferraum und Tankklappe bleiben verriegelt (Diebstahlschutz).

**Notöffnung bei einem Unfall**
Die Türen entriegeln automatisch, wenn bei einem Unfall der Überrollbügel auslöst. Voraussetzung dazu ist, daß der Schlüssel im Lenkschloß gedreht und nicht abgezogen wurde.

**Page Number:** 36 (Bottom left)

This technical diagram is a page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual, specifically detailing the operation of the trunk (Kofferraum) lock and its secondary functions like window closure.

### **Technical Diagram: Trunk Lock Cylinder (Kofferraum)**
The diagram (identified by reference number **P75-0062-813A**) illustrates a trunk lock cylinder with four key positions indicated by red arrows and numerical labels.

*   **Position 1: Ausgangsstellung (Starting Position)** - The vertical position where the key is inserted and removed.
*   **Position 2: Entriegeln (Unlock)** - A counter-clockwise turn used to unlock the trunk.
*   **Position 3: Verriegeln (Raste) (Lock - Detent)** - A clockwise turn to lock the trunk. This position also serves as a trigger for additional electronic functions.
*   **Position 4: Separate Verriegelung (Separate Locking)** - A further clockwise turn beyond position 3. The text notes "Schlüssel in dieser Stellung abziehen" (remove key in this position) to keep the trunk locked independently of the central locking system (valet mode).

### **Text Content and Technical Details**

**Notes (Hinweise):**
*   **Valet Locking:** If the trunk needs to remain locked (e.g., at a workshop), only the secondary key (Nebenschlüssel) should be left with the vehicle while the trunk is locked in position 4.
*   **Theft Protection:** The trunk and fuel flap (Tankklappe) remain locked even if a door is unlocked from the inside of an externally locked vehicle.
*   **Central Locking Link:** Unlocking the trunk lid also unlocks all doors and the fuel flap. After closing the trunk lid, the vehicle must be centrally locked again.
*   **Manual Override:** If the fuel flap does not open on an unlocked vehicle, refer to "Open fuel flap mechanically" on page 135.

**Closing Side Windows (Seitenscheiben schließen):**
*   **Operation:** Holding the key in a door lock or the trunk lock cylinder in **Position 3** for approximately **one second** initiates the automatic closing of the side windows.
*   **Safety Warning (Achtung!):** Users must monitor the closing process to prevent injury from trapping.
*   **Emergency Stop:** Turning the key back to the vertical position (**Position 1**) immediately stops the window closure.
*   **Reset Procedure:** If the closing process is interrupted, it can only be resumed by turning the key to unlock position (**Position 2**) first, then back to locking position (**Position 3**).

### **Additional Information:**
*   **Page Number:** 37
*   **Section:** Bedienung (Operation) - indicated by the vertical red bar on the right edge.
*   **Part Numbers/Reference Numbers:** P75-0062-813A (Diagram ID).

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p40_img1.jpeg]
This image is page 38 of a German-language technical manual for a Mercedes-Benz R129, detailing the operation of the infrared remote control system. It consists of three annotated illustrations and descriptive text.

### **Component Identification**

The diagrams use a numbering system to identify key components:

*   **1 - Sendetaste (Transmit Button):** The main button on the infrared key fob, marked with a Mercedes-Benz star.
*   **2 - Senderausgang und Batteriekontrolle (Transmitter Output and Battery Check):** The infrared emitter located at the front edge of the key fob. This also serves as a battery status indicator.
*   **3 - Empfänger (Receiver):** Located in two places on the vehicle:
    *   **Empfänger im Türgriff:** An infrared receiver unit integrated into the exterior door handle.
    *   **Empfänger unter dem Kofferraum-Schließzylinder:** An infrared receiver unit located directly below the trunk's lock cylinder.

### **Technical Specifications and Measurements**

*   **Operating Distance:** The maximum range for the remote to operate is **6 meters (max. 6 m)**.
*   **Visual Indicators:** The receivers (3) feature **green control lights (grünen Kontrolleuchten)** that flash during the unlocking process and turn off once the vehicle is unlocked.

### **Diagram Reference Numbers**

Technical reference numbers are visible at the bottom right of each illustration:
*   Key fob diagram: **2203**
*   Door handle diagram: **P72-0321-413**
*   Trunk lock diagram: **P75-0001-413**

### **Transcribed Text and Instructions**

**Infrarot-Fernbedienung (Infrared Remote Control)**
*   The system allows for central locking and unlocking of the vehicle.
*   The transmitter is in the remote, while receivers are next to door locks and under the trunk lock cylinder.

**Entriegeln (Unlocking)**
*   **Procedure:** Aim the transmitter output (2) at a receiver (3) and press the transmit button (1).
*   **Range:** Maximum distance of 6 meters.
*   **Confirmation:** Green lights on the receiver will flash and then go out when the vehicle is successfully unlocked.

**Hinweis (Note)**
*   The trunk remains locked if it was previously locked separately (refers to instructions on page 37).

**Page Number:** 38 (bottom left).

text:
[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p41_img1.jpeg]
This technical document page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual (page 39) describes the operation of the infrared remote control main key.

### **Components and Features**
*   **Infrared Remote Control Key Fob:** A rectangular black key fob with a central Mercedes-Benz star logo.
*   **Release Button (Label 4):** A silver circular button located on the top corner of the fob.
*   **Key Blade (Hauptschlüssel):** A metal key blade that folds out from the fob housing.
*   **Transmitter Output (Senderausgang) (2):** Referred to in the text, located at the front of the fob.
*   **Transmitter Button (Sendetaste) (1):** The main button on the fob used for locking and window operation.
*   **Diagram Identifier:** The number **2202** is printed below the key illustration.

### **Measurements and Specifications**
*   **Operating Distance:** Maximum **6 meters** between the transmitter and receiver.
*   **Indicator Duration:** Red control lights flash for a maximum of **10 seconds** if a door or trunk is not properly closed.
*   **Response Time:** Side windows begin to close after holding the button for approximately **1 second**.

### **Functional Instructions**
*   **Locking (Verriegeln):** Point the transmitter at a receiver and press button (1). Red lights on the receivers will flash and then turn off once locked.
*   **Key Unfolding:** Pressing the release button (**4**) causes the key blade to flip out automatically.
*   **Key Folding:** Press the release button (**4**) and manually fold the key blade back into the housing.
*   **Window Closing (Seitenscheiben schließen):** Continue holding button (1) after locking to close the windows. Releasing the button immediately stops the process for safety.

### **Visible Text Transcription**

**Left Column:**
*   **Verriegeln:** Senderausgang (2) auf einen Empfänger (3) richten und Sendetaste (1) drücken. Abstand zum Empfänger max. 6 m. An den Empfängern blinken die roten Kontrolleuchten. Sie erlöschen, wenn das Fahrzeug verriegelt ist.
*   **Hinweis:** Ist das Schloß einer Tür oder des Kofferraumdeckels nicht richtig geschlossen, blinken die roten Kontrolleuchten weiter (max. 10 Sekunden). Die Tür oder den Kofferraumdeckel öffnen, richtig schließen und nochmals verriegeln.

**Center Column:**
*   **4** Entriegelungsknopf für den Hauptschlüssel
*   **Hauptschlüssel in der Infrarot-Fernbedienung**
*   **Ausklappen:** Entriegelungsknopf (4) drücken. Der Schlüssel klappt selbsttätig aus dem Gehäuse.
*   **Einklappen:** Entriegelungsknopf (4) drücken und Schlüssel von Hand ins Gehäuse klappen.

**Right Column:**
*   **Seitenscheiben schließen:** Sendetaste (1) nach dem Verriegeln weiterhin gedrückt halten. Nach ca. einer Sekunde beginnen die Scheiben zu schließen.
*   **Achtung!** Den Schließvorgang überwachen, damit niemand durch Einklemmen verletzt wird. Bei Gefahr die Sendetaste loslassen — der Schließvorgang der Seitenscheiben wird sofort unterbrochen. Die Seitenscheiben können mit den Schaltern im Fahrzeug abgesenkt werden.
*   **Hinweis:** Läßt sich das Fahrzeug mit der Sendetaste (1) nicht ver- oder entriegeln, ist ein Batteriewechsel im Sender oder eine Synchronisation der Anlage notwendig, siehe „Praktische Ratschläge", Seite 128.

**Margins/Footer:**
*   **Bedienung** (Vertical text on right side, indicates "Operation" section)
*   **39** (Page number at bottom right)

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p42_img1.jpeg]
This image is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual, specifically detailing the **Interior Central Locking (Innenzentralverriegelung)** system. It features a diagram of the center console and glove box area with a functional breakdown of the locking mechanism.

### Components and Controls
*   **Glove Box Lock Cylinder:** Shown with three distinct key positions labeled 1, 2, and 3.
    *   **Position 1 (Top/Vertical):** Initial position. Coupling with the central locking system.
    *   **Position 2 (Right/Clockwise):** Separate locking mode.
    *   **Position 3 (Left/Counter-clockwise):** Emergency operation.
*   **Control Buttons:** Two buttons located above and below the lock cylinder with white upward and downward-pointing arrows.
*   **Storage Compartments:** The system controls the locking of several areas:
    *   Glove box (Handschuhfach)
    *   Glasses compartment in the instrument panel (Ablagefach/Brillenfach)
    *   Door pockets (Türtaschen)
    *   Rear storage compartments (Ablagefächer im Fond)
    *   Storage compartments between the front seats (Ablagefächer zwischen den Vordersitzen)

### Operational Details
*   **Coupling with Central Locking:** In position 1, the storage compartments lock and unlock automatically when the vehicle is locked/unlocked from the outside.
*   **Separate Locking:** By turning the key to position 2 and removing it, the storage compartments remain locked even if the rest of the car is unlocked from the outside. Unlocking is achieved by turning the key back to position 1.
*   **Theft Protection:** If the car is locked from the outside and a door is opened from the inside, the storage compartments remain locked.
*   **Emergency Operation:** In case of a defect, the glove box and glasses compartment can be opened by turning the key to position 3, then back to 1, and pressing the arrow buttons.

### Visible Text and Identifying Marks
*   **Main Title:** Innenzentralverriegelung
*   **Subtitles:** Koppelung mit der Zentralverriegelung; Ablagefächer separat ver- und entriegeln; Hinweise.
*   **Diagram Identifier:** P75-0001-813A (located at the bottom right of the illustration).
*   **Page Number:** 40 (bottom left).
*   **Control Labels:** The text uses symbols for the buttons: a white upward-pointing arrow in a black square and a white downward-pointing arrow in a black square.

This is a technical page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's or service manual, specifically page 42, which details the operation and safety considerations for the power front seats.

### **Diagram Description**
The diagram features a line drawing of the seat adjustment switch located on the door panel, which is shaped like a car seat for intuitive use.
*   **Component A (Seat Cushion Switch):** The horizontal base of the switch. It features red double-headed arrows indicating it can move the seat cushion forward/backward and up/down.
*   **Component B (Backrest Switch):** The vertical part of the switch. A curved red double-headed arrow indicates it controls the tilt angle of the backrest.
*   **Component C (Headrest Switch):** The top-most part of the switch. A vertical red double-headed arrow indicates it adjusts the height of the headrest.
*   **Reference Number:** The small number **2216** is visible at the bottom right corner of the diagram box.

### **Text Content and Instructions**

**Main Heading: Vordersitze (Front Seats)**
*   The text states that switches are located in the doors.
*   **Operation Conditions:** The seats can be adjusted when the key is in steering lock position 1 or 2. If the door is open, adjustment is also possible with the key removed or in position 0.

**Adjustment (Einstellen):**
*   **A: Sitzkissen** (Seat cushion)
*   **B: Rückenlehne** (Backrest)
*   **C: Kopfstütze mit Gurthöheneinstellung** (Headrest with belt height adjustment).
*   **Specific Instructions:**
    *   Adjust the headrest so the seat belt runs over the middle of the collarbone.
    *   The headrest can also be tilted forward manually by hand.

**Notes (Hinweise):**
The manual describes an automated safety feature to prevent damage to the convertible top compartment:
*   If the seat cushion is moved backward and the backrest touches the soft-top compartment, the backrest will automatically move to a more upright position.
*   If the backrest is tilted backward and touches the soft-top compartment, the entire seat will automatically move forward.

**Warnings (Achtung!):**
*   **Belt Safety:** Improper seating positions that interfere with correct seat belt routing are a safety risk and must be avoided.
*   **Backrest Position:** The backrest should be nearly upright. The occupant's back must rest against the seat, and the belt must be snug against the shoulder.
*   **Safety Protocol:** For safety reasons, only adjust the seat when the vehicle is stationary.
*   **Entrapment Warning:** Ensure no one is trapped or pinched while the seat is being adjusted.

**Page Number:** 42 (located at the bottom left).

This technical diagram from a Mercedes-Benz R129 document illustrates the seat memory control panel and provides instructions for its operation.

### **Components and Labels**
The diagram (labeled **P91.0001-613A** at the bottom right of the illustration) shows a door-mounted control panel featuring a seat-shaped adjustment switch and a row of memory buttons.

*   **D: Speichertaste (Memory Button):** A square button located to the right of the numbered buttons, used to initiate the saving process.
*   **E: Positionstasten '1', '2', '3' (Position Buttons):** Three rectangular buttons numbered 1, 2, and 3, used to store and recall specific seating, steering wheel, and mirror configurations.
*   **Seat Adjustment Switch:** Located above the memory buttons, shaped like a seat to control the cushion, backrest, and headrest positions.

### **Visible Text Transcription**

**Lower Left Legend:**
*   **Einstellung speichern** (Save setting)
*   **D** Speichertaste
*   **E** Positionstasten „1", „2", „3"

**Center Column Text (Instructions for Saving):**
*   "Nach der Einstellung des Sitzes und der Kopfstütze die Speichertaste D drücken, loslassen und innerhalb von 3 Sekunden die Positionstaste „1" drücken. Auf den Positionstasten „2" und „3" können weitere Einstellungen gespeichert werden."
*   "Fahrzeuge mit Speicherung der Lenkrad- und Spiegeleinstellung: Zusammen mit der Sitzeinstellung Lenkrad und Spiegel einstellen und auf der gleichen Positionstaste speichern."
*   "Lenkradeinstellung siehe Seite 47 und Spiegeleinstellung siehe Seiten 58 und 59."

**Right Column Text (Instructions for Recalling):**
*   **Gespeicherte Einstellung abrufen** (Recall saved setting)
*   "Positionstaste „1", „2" oder „3" so lange drücken, bis der Einstellvorgang beendet ist."
*   "Hinweis: Wird die Positionstaste vorher losgelassen, ist aus Sicherheitsgründen der Einstellvorgang sofort unterbrochen."

**Additional Annotations:**
*   **Bedienung** (Operation): Located vertically in the right-hand red margin.
*   **43**: Page number at the bottom right.

This is a technical page (page 44) from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document detailing the operation of the seat backrests and orthopedic adjustments.

### **Section 1: Seat Backrest Operation (Left Illustration)**

The illustration (labeled with reference number **P91-0302-B13**) shows a perspective view of the front seat from behind, highlighting the backrest release mechanism and integrated seat belt. A small red arrow indicates the operation of the release handle.

*   **Components and Labels:**
    *   **Rückenlehne:** Backrest.
    *   **Griff:** Release handle located on the upper outer side of the seat.
    *   **Sicherheitsgurt:** Integrated seat belt.
    *   **Warning Icon:** A faint icon of a seat with a warning symbol is shown to the right, representing the dashboard warning light.

*   **Operating Instructions (Translated from German):**
    *   **Folding Forward (Vorklappen):** Pull the handle and fold the backrest forward.
    *   **Folding Back (Zurückklappen):** Allow the backrest to audibly click into the locking mechanism.
    *   **Safety Warning (Achtung!):** The seat belts' protective function is only guaranteed when the backrests are locked.
    *   **Warning Indicators:** If the backrest/seatbelt warning light stays on continuously instead of turning off after flashing, the backrest is not locked. A warning chime will sound for approximately 20 seconds.
    *   **Locking Procedure:** Ensure there is space behind the seat, then push the backrest back until it audibly clicks. The warning light will extinguish once locked. If it remains on, the system requires service at a Mercedes-Benz station.

---

### **Section 2: Orthopedic Backrest Controls (Right Illustration)**

The illustration (labeled with reference number **P91-0310 B13**) provides a close-up view of the adjustment thumbwheels, typically located on the inner side of the seat base.

*   **Components and Numbered Labels:**
    *   **1 - Druckwähler (Pressure Selector):** The upper thumbwheel, marked with numbers 0-4 and a backrest icon with horizontal lines, adjusts the firmness/thickness of the air cushions.
    *   **2 - Höhenwähler (Height Selector):** The lower thumbwheel, marked with a backrest icon and vertical arrows, adjusts the vertical position (height) of the backrest curvature.

*   **Operating Instructions (Translated from German):**
    *   **System Description:** The backrest contains air cushions to support the spine.
    *   **Operational Requirement:** Adjustments to the thickness and height of the backrest curvature can only be made when the ignition key is in steering lock position 2 (ignition on).

---

### **General Information:**
*   **Page Number:** 44 (visible in the bottom left corner).
*   **Part/Reference Numbers:** P91-0302-B13 (left diagram), P91-0310 B13 (right diagram).
*   **Wire Colors/Measurements:** None specified in this document.

This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual focusing on the rear seats (Fondsitze) and their adjustments.

### Image 1 (Left Overview Diagram)
*   **Description:** A black-and-white illustration showing the rear passenger compartment.

*   **Component 2:** A holder or "Höhenwähler" located at the base of the backrest near the center console.

### Image 2 (Right Detail Diagram)
*   **Description:** A close-up view of the latching mechanism for folding the seat.
*   **Component 3:** An arrow pointing down to a textured/corrugated surface ("Riffelung") to indicate where to apply downward pressure.
*   **Component 4:** An arrow pointing to the hook of the holder to indicate how to unhook it.
*   **Illustration Label:** P53-8003-B13

### Measurements and Settings
*   **Pressure Adjustment (1):** Infinitely adjustable between settings "0" (pressureless) and "4" (full pressure) for the air cushions in the backrest.
*   **Height Adjustment (2):** Five settings for lumbar support height, ranging from "a" (lowest support) to "e" (highest support).

### Visible Text
*   **Left Column:** Describes the use of the pressure selector (1) and height selector (2) for the backrest curvature (Lehnenwölbung). It notes that after a driving interruption, the last selected setting is automatically restored.
*   **Middle Column:** 
    *   **Fondsitze** (Rear seats)
    *   **Vorklappen:** (Folding forward): Pull handle (1) and fold the backrest forward. To secure the backrest, press down on the holder (2) at the corrugation (3) and hook it over the backrest.
*   **Right Column:**
    *   **Zurückklappen:** (Folding back): Unhook holder (4), stand the backrest up, and let it click audibly into the lock.
*   **Vertical Margin Text:** **Bedienung** (Operation)
*   **Page Number:** 45 (Bottom right)

No part numbers or wire colors are present in these diagrams.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p48_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical document page from a Mercedes-Benz manual, specifically detailing the operation and logic of the **Sitzheizung** (Seat Heating) system.

### **Components and Visuals**
*   **Switch (Sitzheizungsschalter):** A vertically oriented rocker switch is pictured.
    *   It features two seat icons with wavy heat lines.
    *   There are two small round indicator lights (LEDs) located between the icons.
*   **Image Identifier:** Below the switch image to the right is the alphanumeric code **P82-0012-61A**.
*   **Page Number:** **46** is located at the bottom left.

### **Operating Instructions**
The text describes the manual and automatic functions of the system:
*   **Requirements:** The key must be in the steering lock in position 1 or 2.
*   **Switching On (Einschalten):**
    *   **Normal Mode:** Pressing the top of the switch activates normal heating. One indicator light illuminates.
    *   **Rapid Heating Mode:** Pressing the bottom of the switch activates rapid heating. Both indicator lights illuminate.
    *   **Automatic Transition:** After approximately 5 minutes, the system automatically switches from rapid heating to normal mode, and one light turns off.
*   **Switching Off (Ausschalten):** 
    *   If one light is on, press the top of the switch.
    *   If both lights are on, press the bottom of the switch.
    *   **Automatic Off:** The system shuts down completely after approximately 30 minutes of operation.

### **Technical Logic and Notes (Hinweise)**
*   **Power Management:** The document notes high power consumption.
*   **Load Shedding:** If battery voltage is low or there are too many electrical consumers active, the system may shut off.
    *   **Feedback:** In this state, the indicator lights will flash. 
    *   **Resume:** The system automatically resumes heating once sufficient voltage is restored.
    *   **User Action:** The user can manually switch the system off to stop the flashing lights.

### **Transcribed Text (German)**
**Sitzheizung**
Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 1 oder 2.

**Einschalten:**
Schalter oben drücken = normaler Heizbetrieb. Eine Kontrolleuchte im Schalter leuchtet auf.
Schalter unten drücken = schnelle Aufheizung. Beide Kontrolleuchten im Schalter leuchten auf.
Nach ca. 5 Minuten schaltet die Sitzheizung automatisch auf normalen Heizbetrieb um und es leuchtet nur noch eine Kontrolleuchte auf.

**Ausschalten:**
Leuchtet eine Kontrolleuchte auf, Schalter oben drücken.
Leuchten beide Kontrolleuchten auf, Schalter unten drücken.
Die Sitzheizung schaltet nach ca. 30 Minuten automatisch ab.

**Hinweise:**
Die Sitzheizung hat einen hohen Stromverbrauch. Deshalb die Sitzheizung nicht länger als notwendig eingeschaltet lassen.
Sind viele Stromverbraucher eingeschaltet oder ist die Batterie nicht ausreichend geladen, kann sich die Sitzheizung abschalten. In diesem Fall blinkt die Kontrolleuchte im Schalter (bei schneller Aufheizung blinken beide Kontrolleuchten). Sobald wieder genügend Spannung vorhanden ist, schaltet sich die Sitzheizung selbsttätig ein.
Wird das Blinken der Kontrolleuchten als störend empfunden, kann die Sitzheizung mit dem Schalter ausgeschaltet werden.

This is a technical page from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, page 47, focusing on the operation of the center armrest and the steering wheel adjustment.

### **Section 1: Armrest Adjustment (Armauflage)**

*   **Components:**
    *   **Center Armrest:** Located between the front seats.
    *   **Adjustment Button (1):** A button located on the top front edge of the sliding armrest cover.
*   **Operational Instructions:**
    *   **Heading:** Armauflage (Armrest)
    *   **Process:** To adjust, press button **(1)** and slide the armrest cover forward or backward.
    *   **Measurement:** The armrest has **7 Rasten** (7 detents/notched positions) for adjustment.
*   **Image Reference Code:** P77-0004-13C (located at the bottom right of the illustration).

---

### **Section 2: Steering Wheel Adjustment (Lenkrad einstellen)**

*   **Components:**
    *   **Adjustment Switch (1):** A small joystick-style switch located on the left side of the steering column.
    *   **Steering Column:** Shows the area housing the ignition and adjustment controls.
*   **Operational Conditions:**
    *   The adjustment can be made when the key is in the steering lock at position 1 or 2.
    *   Adjustment is also possible with the door open, even if the key is removed or in position 0.
*   **Operational Instructions:**
    *   **Longitudinal Adjustment (Längsrichtung):** Push switch **(1)** forward or backward to move the steering wheel toward or away from the driver.
    *   **Height Adjustment (Höheneinstellung):** Push switch **(1)** up or down to adjust the height of the steering wheel.
*   **Image Reference Code:** P46-0003-013A (located at the bottom right of the illustration).

---

### **Section 3: Warnings and Additional Information**

*   **Safety Warning (Achtung!):**
    *   **Text:** "Aus Sicherheitsgründen das Lenkrad nur bei Fahrzeugstillstand einstellen."
    *   **Instruction:** For safety reasons, only adjust the steering wheel when the vehicle is at a complete standstill.
*   **Memory Function (Lenkradeinstellung speichern):**
    *   **Text:** "Zusammen mit der Sitz- und Spiegeleinstellung die Lenkradeinstellung speichern und bei Bedarf abrufen, siehe Seite 43."
    *   **Instruction:** The steering wheel position is stored and recalled along with the seat and mirror memory settings (referenced to page 43).
*   **Sidebar Text:** "Bedienung" (Operation/Handling).

*   **Das straffe Anliegen des Gurtes während der Fahrt kontrollieren.** (Check that the belt remains tight during the journey.)
*   **Auf korrekte Sitzposition achten. Die Rückenlehne nahezu aufrechtstellen. Der Rücken muß an der Lehne anliegen.** (Ensure correct seating position. Place the backrest almost upright. The back must rest against the backrest.)

This image is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual, specifically page 50, focusing on the operation of rear seat belts and seat belt pretensioners.

### Diagram Components and Callouts
The illustration shows a top-down view of the rear seats (Fondsitze) with arrows indicating seat belt adjustment and operation.
*   **1 - Schloßzunge (Latch Plate/Tongue):** The metal part of the seat belt that clicks into the buckle.
*   **2 - Gurtschloß (Seat Belt Buckle):** The receptacle for the latch plate.
*   **3 - Lösetaste (Release Button):** The button on the buckle used to release the belt.

### Operational Details from Text
*   **Seat Belt Adjustment:**
    *   To tighten: Pull on the end of the belt when the latch plate is clicked into the buckle.
    *   To lengthen: Position the latch plate at an angle greater than 90 degrees (rechtwinkelig) to the belt webbing and pull.
*   **Safety Instructions (Achtung!):** Emphasizes that incorrectly worn seat belts can lead to injury during an accident. The belt must fit snugly against the hip bone and not be twisted.
*   **Seat Belt Release:** To release, press the release button (3) on the buckle (2) and return the latch plate (1) to its original position.
*   **Gurtstraffer (Belt Pretensioners):**
    *   The text on the right notes that front seats are equipped with belt pretensioners.
    *   They are functional when the belts are fastened and the ignition key is in position 1 or 2.
    *   They are designed to trigger during a frontal collision of a specific severity to pull the belts tight against the body.
    *   Reference is made to safety regulations for belt pretensioners on page 53.

### Visible Text Transcriptions
*   **Heading:** Gurtstraffer
*   **Section Header:** Sicherheitsgurte der Fondsitze
*   **Legend:**
    *   1 Schloßzunge
    *   2 Gurtschloß
    *   3 Lösetaste
*   **Main Text (Left/Center):**
    *   "Fondsitze: Schloßzunge (1) im Gurtschloß (2) einrasten. Der Gurt muß vor den Hüftknochen anliegen. Er darf nicht verdreht sein und muß straff anliegen."
    *   "Zum Straffen den Gurt verkürzen: Bei eingerasteter Schloßzunge am Gurtende ziehen. Gurt verlängern: Schloßzunge vor dem Anlegen des Gurtes etwas mehr als rechtwinkelig zum Gurtband stellen und daran ziehen."
    *   "Achtung! Ein nicht korrekt angelegter Gurt kann bei einem Unfall nicht wie vorgesehen schützen, sondern zu Verletzungen führen. Sitzpositionen, die die korrekte Lage des Sicherheitsgurtes beeinträchtigen, sind aus Sicherheitsgründen zu vermeiden."
    *   "Sicherheitsgurte lösen: Taste (3) im Schloß (2) drücken. Schloßzunge (1) zur Ausgangsstellung zurückführen."
*   **Page Number:** 50 (Bottom left corner)

### Measurements, Part Numbers, and Wires
*   **Measurements:** No numerical dimensions are provided, other than the mention of a "rechtwinkelig" (right-angle/90-degree) position for adjustment.
*   **Part Numbers:** None visible in this document snippet.
*   **Wire Colors:** Not applicable, as this is a mechanical operation diagram.

### **Components and Labels**
The diagram features a cutaway view of the vehicle's interior with two occupants and four numbered components:

1.  **Fahrer-Airbag (Driver Airbag):** Depicted as a large, circular deployed cushion emerging from the steering wheel.
2.  **Beifahrer-Airbag (Passenger Airbag):** Depicted as a rectangular deployed cushion emerging from the dashboard where the glovebox would normally be.
3.  **Kontrolleuchte (Warning lamp):** A small display on the instrument cluster showing the text **"SRS"**.
4.  **Gurtstraffer (Seat belt tensioner):** Indicated at the base of the B-pillar for the driver's seat belt. Red arrows on the belt webbing show the direction of tensioning during activation.

### **Technical Details and Connections**
*   **Wiring:** Thin lines represent electrical connections originating from a central control module area (likely the tunnel/center console area) and branching out to the driver's airbag, passenger's airbag, and the seat belt tensioner.
*   **Visual Indicators:** The diagram shows the driver and passenger in a seated position to demonstrate the spatial relationship of the deployed airbags.

### **Visible Text (German)**
The document section is titled **"Airbag"** (in red) and falls under the category of **"Bedienung"** (Operation), which is printed vertically on a red sidebar.

**Main Text Content:**
*   **1 Fahrer-Airbag**
*   **2 Beifahrer-Airbag**
*   **3 Kontrolleuchte**
*   **4 Gurtstraffer**

**Descriptive Paragraphs:**
*   **Driver Airbag:** States that the driver airbag (1) is located behind the padded plate of the steering wheel, marked by the "SRS-AIRBAG" lettering.
*   **Passenger Airbag:** Explains that the passenger airbag (2) is housed in the dashboard in place of the glove compartment, also marked with "SRS-AIRBAG" lettering.
*   **Activation Logic:** Notes that the airbags are designed to trigger in the event of a frontal collision and only when the impact reaches a precisely defined severity.
*   **Deployment Smoke:** Explains that when airbags deploy, small amounts of smoke are released which are not harmful to health and do not indicate a fire in the vehicle.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p56_img1.jpeg]
This image is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically detailing the ignition lock (**Lenkschloß**) positions and functions.

### Components and Controls
*   **Ignition Lock (Lenkschloß):** The central mechanical component shown in the diagram.
*   **Ignition Key (Schlüssel):** Inserted into the lock.
*   **Steering Lock:** Internal mechanism controlled by the key position.
*   **Automatic Transmission Selector Lever (Wählhebel):** Referenced in the text as interacting with the ignition lock.
*   **Electrical Consumers:** Various systems mentioned that are powered in different key positions.

### Ignition Key Positions (Diagram Labels 0-3)
The diagram uses red arrows and numerical labels to indicate the rotation of the key:
*   **0 (Lock/Off):** The steering is blocked when the key is removed. The key can only be removed in this position. For automatic vehicles, removal is only possible when the gear selector is in "P".
*   **1 (Accessory):** The steering is unlocked. Certain electrical components (listed below) become functional.
*   **2 (Driving/On - Fahrtstellung):** Normal operating position while driving.
*   **3 (Start - Startstellung):** Momentary position used to engage the starter motor.

### Text Transcription (Translated Summary)

**Lenkschloß (Steering Lock)**
*   **0:** Steering is blocked with key removed. Key only removable in position 0. On automatics, only in "P".
*   **1:** Steering is free.
*   **2:** Driving position.
*   **3:** Starting position.

**Hinweise (Notes):**
*   Refers to page 12 for starting/stopping the engine.
*   Warning: Do not remove the key while the vehicle is moving; the steering will lock.
*   Automatic vehicles: In position 0 with the key removed, the gear selector is locked in "P".
*   Battery charging info: The battery charges minimally at idle. It's recommended to turn off high-power consumers (like seat heaters or rear defroster) during slow-moving traffic to prevent battery drain.
*   If the vehicle is parked for a long time, remove the key to prevent battery discharge.

**Electrical Consumers functional in Position 1:**
*   Windshield wipers and washer system.
*   Headlight cleaning system (only if light switch is on).
*   High beam flasher (Lichthupe).
*   Radio.
*   Cigarette lighter.
*   Glove box light.
*   Heated rear window.
*   Front seat adjustment.
*   Seat heating.
*   Steering wheel adjustment.
*   Mirror adjustment.

**Achtung! (Attention!):**
*   Safety warning: Always remove the key even when leaving the vehicle briefly. Do not leave children unattended in the vehicle.

### Technical References and Codes
*   **Diagram Reference Number:** P 46-5052-13 (located directly under the ignition lock illustration).
*   **Page Number:** 54 (bottom left).

### Notable Absences
*   **Measurements:** No physical dimensions are provided.
*   **Part Numbers:** No specific Mercedes-Benz part numbers are listed for the components.
*   **Wire Colors:** This is a functional diagram of the mechanical lock positions, not an electrical wiring schematic; therefore, no wire colors are shown.

### **Left Section: Exterior Light Switch (Lichtschalter)**

(A warning signal sounds if the exterior lights, except parking lights, are left on when the key is removed and a door is opened).

This image is page 56 of a technical service or owner's manual for a Mercedes-Benz R129, detailing the operation of the combination switch (**Kombi-Schalter**) located on the left side of the steering column.

### Illustrations and Labels

The page features two technical illustrations:

*   **Left Illustration (Ref. P82-5073-13A):** Shows the steering wheel and the full combination switch lever.
    *   **1:** Indicated by a downward arrow (pressing the lever away from the driver towards the dashboard).
    *   **2:** Indicated by pushing the lever forward.
    *   **3:** Indicated by pulling the lever backward towards the driver.
    *   **4:** Indicated by two upward arrows (pushing the lever up for right turn signals).
    *   **5:** Indicated by two downward arrows (pushing the lever down for left turn signals).
*   **Middle Illustration (Ref. P82-0006-13):** Shows a close-up of the end of the combination switch lever.
    *   **6:** Indicated by a large red arrow pointing towards the end of the lever (pushing the end of the lever inward).
    *   **7:** Indicated by a curved red arrow around the end of the lever (rotating the tip). Symbols for windshield wiper functions (0, I, II, III) are visible on the rotating sleeve.

### Text and Function Descriptions (Translated from German)

The text describes the functions corresponding to the numbered labels:

**Kombi-Schalter¹ (Combination Switch)**
*   **1 Abblendlicht:** Low beam (active when the main light switch is in the low beam position [symbol shown]).
*   **2 Fernlicht:** High beam (active when the main light switch is in the low beam position [symbol shown]).
*   **3 Lichthupe:** Headlamp flasher (high beam, operates regardless of the main light switch position).
*   **4 Blinkleuchten, rechts:** Turn signals, right.
*   **5 Blinkleuchten, links:** Turn signals, left.
    *   **Blinken:** Lock the combination switch into position; it resets automatically after a significant steering wheel movement.
    *   **Blinken bei kleinen Richtungsänderungen (between illustrations):** For small direction changes, press the switch only to the pressure point and hold it.

**Wiper and Washer Functions**
*   **6 Schalter kurz antippen:** Tap the switch briefly for a single wiping motion without water (recommended for wet windshields).
    *   **Schalter über den Druckpunkt betätigen:** Press the switch past the pressure point to activate the windshield washer, wipers, and headlight cleaning system (only active when light switch is in parking light or low beam position [symbols shown]).
*   **7 Scheibenwischer:** Windshield wipers.
    *   **0:** Aus (Off)
    *   **I:** Intervall-Wischen (Interval wiping)
    *   **II:** Normales Wischen (Normal wiping)
    *   **III:** Schnelles Wischen (Fast wiping)
    *   **Automatic Speed Adjustment:** When the vehicle stops or slows below approx. 25 km/h, the system automatically shifts down one wiper stage. In stage "I", the interval is extended. The previous setting is restored upon acceleration.

### Additional Information
*   **Hinweis (Note):** The water reservoir, hoses, and nozzles of the windshield washer system are automatically heated.
*   **Footnote 1:** Mentions that legal regulations in certain countries may cause deviations from these descriptions.
*   **Page Number:** 56 is located at the bottom left.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p60_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically page 58, detailing the operation and features of the power exterior mirrors (**Außenspiegel**).

### Component Overview and Illustration
The image features a black-and-white illustration (reference number **P81-0082-B13D**) of the mirror adjustment switch located on the center console (**Mittelkonsole**).

*   **Switch Type:** A multi-functional rotary and joystick-style switch.
*   **Selector Positions:**
    *   **1 (Left):** Rotate the switch knob to this position to select the driver-side (left) mirror.
    *   **2 (Right):** Rotate the switch knob to this position to select the passenger-side (right) mirror.
*   **Adjustment Movement:** Indicated by four straight red arrows, the entire switch assembly can be moved forward, backward, or sideways like a joystick to adjust the angle of the selected mirror glass.
*   **Rotational Movement:** Indicated by two curved red arrows showing the turning action to select between position 1 and 2.

### Technical Instructions and Operation
*   **Activation:** The ignition key must be in position 2 (**Stellung 2**) in the steering lock for the switch to function.
*   **Heated Mirrors:** The mirrors are automatically heated (**automatisch beheizt**) at low outside temperatures.
*   **Manual Override/Reset:**
    *   If the mirror housing is forcibly pushed forward (disengaged), it must be clicked back into place by applying strong pressure.
    *   If the mirror housing has been pushed backward manually, it should be readjusted using the switch.
*   **Memory Function:** Exterior mirror settings can be saved and recalled in conjunction with seat, steering wheel, and interior mirror settings (referenced to page 43).

### Important Warnings
*   **Convex Mirror Note (Achtung!):** The passenger-side mirror provides a reduced image (**verkleinert ab**). This means objects appear further away than they actually are.

### Visible Text Summary
*   **Headings:** "Außenspiegel" (Exterior Mirrors), "Spiegeleinstellung speichern" (Save Mirror Setting), "Achtung!" (Attention!).
*   **Key points:** "Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2", "1 Spiegel links", "2 Spiegel rechts".
*   **Page number:** 58.
*   **Illustration ID:** P81-0082-B13D.

This is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 SL-Class owner's manual (specifically page 59) detailing the operation and adjustment of the interior rearview mirror.

### Visual Components

1.  **Left Illustration (Manual Mirror):**
    *   **Subject:** Interior rearview mirror assembly mounted to the overhead console.
    *   **Features:** Shows a standard interior mirror with a day/night anti-dazzle lever at the bottom center.
    *   **Annotation:** A red curved double-ended arrow indicates manual directional adjustment.
    *   **Reference Number:** `P81-0272-B11` in the bottom right corner of the illustration box.

2.  **Center Illustration (Electric Adjustment Switch):**
    *   **Subject:** Detail view of the mirror adjustment joystick, typically located on the center console.
    *   **Features:** A textured circular knob with a central vertical line indicator.
    *   **Annotation:** Four red arrows pointing Up, Down, Left, and Right, indicating the possible directions for adjustment.
    *   **Reference Number:** `P81-0007-B13A` in the bottom right corner of the illustration box.

### Text Descriptions and Instructions

**Heading (Left): Innenspiegel (Interior Mirror)**
*   **Instruction:** "Spiegel nach Bedarf von Hand einstellen." (Adjust mirror manually as needed.)
*   **Anti-dazzle instruction:** "Abblendstellung: Mit dem Hebel an der Spiegelunterkante den Spiegel umklappen." (Anti-dazzle position: Flip the mirror using the lever on the lower edge of the mirror.)

**Heading (Center): Innenspiegel, elektrisch einstellbar (Interior Mirror, electrically adjustable)**
*   **Location:** "Der Schalter für die Außen- und Innenspiegeleinstellung befindet sich auf der Mittelkonsole." (The switch for exterior and interior mirror adjustment is located on the center console.)
*   **Operation Condition:** "Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2." (Key in steering lock in position 2.)
*   **Operation Method:** "Den Schalter in Mittelstellung drehen und zum Einstellen nach vorn, zurück oder seitlich bewegen." (Turn the switch to the center position and move it forward, back, or sideways to adjust.)
*   **Manual Override:** "Abblendstellung: Mit dem Hebel an der Spiegelunterkante den Spiegel umklappen." (Anti-dazzle position: Flip the mirror using the lever on the lower edge of the mirror.)

**Heading (Right): Spiegeleinstellung speichern (Save mirror setting)**
*   **Memory Function:** "Zusammen mit der Sitz-, Lenkrad- und Außenspiegeleinstellung die Innenspiegeleinstellung speichern und bei Bedarf abrufen, siehe Seite 43." (Save the interior mirror setting along with the seat, steering wheel, and exterior mirror settings and recall as needed, see page 43.)
*   **Hinweis (Note):** "Wurde der Innenspiegel mechanisch verstellt, bleibt die gespeicherte Stellung erhalten. Zum Abrufen die Positionstaste „1", „2" oder „3" drücken." (If the interior mirror was adjusted mechanically, the stored position is retained. To recall, press position button "1", "2" or "3".)

### Other Technical Data
*   **Page Number:** `59` (bottom right).
*   **Section Title:** `Bedienung` (Operation), located vertically in a red bar on the right edge.

text:
[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p62_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical page (page 60) from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, written in German. It describes the operation of the sun visors and the procedure for setting the vehicle's clock.

### **Illustrations**
The page features two black-and-white illustrations:
*   **Left Illustration (Fig. P81-0005-B13):** Shows the driver-side sun visor. Red curved arrows indicate the visor can swing down from the ceiling to block front glare and can be unclipped from its inner mount to swing sideways to block glare from the side window.
*   **Right Illustration (Fig. P81-0008-B13):** Shows the sun visor with the vanity mirror cover open. A red double-headed arrow indicates the opening/closing motion of the cover.

### **Components & Connections**
*   **Sonnenblende (Sun Visor):** Hinged at the outer upper corner of the windshield.
*   **Lagerung an der Innenseite (Inner Holder/Clip):** A mounting point near the rearview mirror where the sun visor clips in.
*   **Beleuchteter Spiegel (Illuminated Mirror):** A vanity mirror built into the sun visor.
*   **Deckel (Cover):** A hinged flap covering the vanity mirror.
*   **Beleuchtung (Lighting):** Integrated lights that activate when the mirror cover is opened, provided the visor is clipped into its inner holder.
*   **Stellknopf (Adjustment Knob):** A physical knob on the instrument cluster (referenced in text, not shown in diagrams) used to set the clock.

### **Text Content (Translated Summary)**

**Sonnenblenden (Sun Visors):**
*   Swing down to protect from front glare.
*   Unclip from the inner holder and swing to the side for side-window glare.
*   When swung to the side, the visor can be adjusted longitudinally (slid along its arm).

**Sonnenblenden mit beleuchtetem Spiegel (Sun Visors with Illuminated Mirror):**
*   The light turns on automatically when the cover is opened.
*   **Note:** The visor must be clipped into its inner mount for the light to function.

**Uhrzeit einstellen (Setting the Time):**
*   Refers to page 10 ("Kombi-Instrument") for the location of the adjustment knob.
*   **Advance time:** Pull the knob out and turn right.
*   **Rewind time:** Pull the knob out and turn left.
*   **Adjust by one minute:** Briefly pull, turn, and release the knob.
*   **Adjust by several minutes:** Pull, turn, and hold the knob.
*   **Adjustment speed:** During the first 2 seconds of holding, the clock advances 8 minutes; after that, it advances 8 minutes for every subsequent second.

### **Technical Identifiers**
*   **Figure Numbers:** P81-0005-B13, P81-0008-B13
*   **Page Number:** 60

### Components and Controls

The document describes two main rocker switches located above the interior rearview mirror:

#### 1. Innenleuchten (Interior Lights Switch)
Shown in the left illustration (reference number **P82-0043-B13**).
*   **Position 1 (Left side):** Door-activated mode. The switch shows an icon of a car with an open door and light rays.
    *   **Function:** Interior lights turn on automatically when the vehicle is unlocked or a door is opened. They turn off with a delay when the vehicle is locked or all doors are closed.
*   **Position 2 (Middle):** Permanent Off.
    *   **Function:** Interior lights remain switched off.
*   **Position 3 (Right side):** Permanent On. The switch shows an icon of a light source with rays.
    *   **Function:** Interior lights remain switched on continuously.

#### 2. Leseleuchten (Reading Lights Switch)
Shown in the right illustration (reference number **P82-0044-B11**).
*   **Position 4 (Left side):** Left reading light. The icon shows an open book with light rays coming from the left.
    *   **Function:** Switches on the left reading light.
*   **Position 5 (Middle):** Off.
    *   **Function:** Reading lights are switched off.
*   **Position 6 (Right side):** Right reading light. The icon shows an open book with light rays coming from the right.
    *   **Function:** Switches on the right reading light.

### Additional Lighting Components
The text also describes automatic lights that do not have manual switches on the overhead console:

*   **Einstiegleuchten (Entry Lights):** Located under the dashboard in the footwell area.
*   **Ausstiegleuchten (Exit Lights):** Located on the door pockets.
*   **Operation:** These lights are activated and deactivated automatically by the contact switches located in the doors.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p64_img1.jpeg]
This is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, detailing interior components on the dashboard and center console.

### Left Illustration: Dashboard Storage Compartments
The diagram labeled **P68-0001-B13A** shows the center stack controls for two storage compartments.

*   **Component Numbers:**
    *   **1:** Brillenfach (Glasses compartment) – The upper storage area above the air vents.
    *   **2:** Taste für Brillenfach (Button for glasses compartment) – The upper button with an upward arrow.
    *   **3:** Handschuhfach (Glove compartment) – The large compartment on the passenger side.
    *   **4:** Taste für Handschuhfach (Button for glove compartment) – The lower button with a downward arrow.
    *   **5:** Schloß (Lock) – A key cylinder located between buttons 2 and 4.

*   **Operational Instructions (Summary of German text):**
    *   **Opening:** Press button (2) for the glasses compartment or button (4) for the glovebox.
    *   **Manual Locking:** Insert the master key into lock (5), turn it to the right, and remove it.
    *   **Manual Unlocking:** Turn the master key back to its initial vertical position.
    *   **Central Locking:** Note states that vehicles equipped with interior central locking can lock and unlock these compartments automatically (referencing page 40).

### Right Illustration: Cigarette Lighter
The diagram labeled **P61-0003-B13** shows the center console area containing the lighter and ashtray.

*   **Component Numbers:**
    *   **1:** Jalousie (Sliding cover/blind) – The retractable cover over the lighter area.
    *   **2:** Zigarrenanzünder (Cigarette lighter) – The push-style lighter unit.

*   **Operational Instructions (Summary of German text):**
    *   Requires the ignition key in position 1 or 2.
    *   Slide the cover (1) forward to access.
    *   Press the lighter (2) in; it will pop out automatically once the heating element is glowing.

### Full Text Transcription
**Ablagefächer in der Armaturenanlage**
1. Brillenfach
2. Taste für Brillenfach
3. Handschuhfach
4. Taste für Handschuhfach
5. Schloß

**Brillenfach**
Brillenfach (1) öffnen: Taste (2) drücken.
Verriegeln: Hauptschlüssel im Schloß (5) nach rechts drehen und abziehen.
Entriegeln: Hauptschlüssel in seine Ausgangsstellung zurückdrehen.
Fahrzeuge mit Innenzentralverriegelung: Das Ablagefach kann zentral ver- und entriegelt werden. Siehe Seite 40.

**Handschuhfach**
Handschuhfach (3) öffnen: Taste (4) drücken.
Verriegeln: Hauptschlüssel im Schloß (5) nach rechts drehen und abziehen.
Entriegeln: Hauptschlüssel in seine Ausgangsstellung zurückdrehen.
Fahrzeuge mit Innenzentralverriegelung: Das Handschuhfach kann zentral ver- und entriegelt werden. Siehe Seite 40.

**Zigarrenanzünder**
1. Jalousie
2. Zigarrenanzünder
Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 1 oder 2.
Jalousie (1) nach vorne schieben.
Zigarrenanzünder (2) eindrücken; er springt selbsttätig zurück, wenn die Spirale glüht.

**Page Number:** 62

This image is page 63 of a Mercedes-Benz R129 technical or owner's manual from the **Bedienung** (Operation) section. It features three annotated diagrams illustrating various storage compartments in the vehicle's interior.

### 1. Storage Compartments Between Front Seats
*   **Title:** Ablagefächer zwischen den Vordersitzen
*   **Image ID:** P97-0003-B13
*   **Components and Operation:**
    *   **Vordere Ablage (Front storage):** Intended for cassettes or CDs. It is opened by sliding the louver, labeled **(1)** with a red arrow, towards the rear.
    *   **Hintere Ablage (Rear storage):** Opened by pressing button **(2)** on the side of the armrest; the lid then opens automatically (indicated by an upward red arrow).
*   **Notes:** Vehicles equipped with interior central locking (**Innenzentralverriegelung**) can lock and unlock these compartments centrally (cross-reference to page 40).

### 2. Door Pockets
*   **Title:** Türtaschen
*   **Image ID:** P72-0033-B13A
*   **Components and Operation:**
    *   The diagram shows the door interior panel with an upward red arrow on the pocket lid. To open, the lid is flipped upwards (**Deckel aufklappen**).
*   **Notes:** Like the console compartments, these can be centrally locked/unlocked on equipped vehicles (cross-reference to page 40).

### 3. Rear Storage Compartments (Vehicles without rear seats)
*   **Title:** Ablagefächer im Fond
*   **Subtitle:** Fahrzeuge ohne Fondsitze
*   **Image ID:** P91-0001-B13
*   **Components and Operation:**
    *   Diagram illustrates the storage area behind the front seats.
    *   To open, press the button/latch labeled **(1)** and flip the cover upwards as indicated by the red arrows.
*   **Notes:** These compartments also interface with the interior central locking system on equipped models (cross-reference to page 40).

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p66_img1.jpeg]
This image is page 64 from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual, detailing the operation of the heated rear window system.

### Components and Visual Elements
*   **Heated Rear Window Switch:** A black, rectangular rocker-style switch. It features a white icon in the top half consisting of a rectangle with three wavy vertical arrows pointing upwards, symbolizing heat.
*   **Indicator Light (Kontrolleuchte):** A small circular light integrated into the lower half of the switch assembly.
*   **Page Number:** The number "64" is located at the bottom left corner.

### System Connections and Operation (Per Text)
*   **Location:** The switch is located in the vehicle's center console.
*   **Operational Requirements:** The ignition key must be in the steering lock at position 1 or 2 for the system to function.
*   **Automatic Features:**
    *   **Timer:** The system automatically switches off after a maximum of 20 minutes.
    *   **Load Management:** The system may shut down if the battery charge is insufficient or if there is a high electrical load.
*   **Indicator Feedback:** 
    *   **Steady Light:** System is active.
    *   **Flashing Light:** System has deactivated due to power/voltage issues; it will automatically reactivate once sufficient voltage is restored.

### Visible Text (German)
*   **Header (Red):** "Heizbare Heckscheibe" (Heated Rear Window)
*   **Main Body Text:** 
    *   "Der Schalter befindet sich in der Mittelkonsole."
    *   "Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 1 oder 2."
    *   "Bei eingeschalteter Heckscheibenheizung leuchtet die Kontrolleuchte im Schalter auf."
*   **Notes Section ("Hinweise:"):**
    *   "Eine von außen vereiste oder zugeschneite Heckscheibe vor dem Einschalten freimachen."
    *   "Die heizbare Heckscheibe hat einen hohen Stromverbrauch. Deshalb Heckscheibenheizung abschalten, sobald die Scheibe beschlagfrei ist."
*   **Right Column Text:**
    *   "Die Heckscheibenheizung schaltet nach spätestens 20 Minuten automatisch ab."
    *   "Sind viele Stromverbraucher eingeschaltet oder die Batterie ist nicht ausreichend geladen, kann sich die Heckscheibenheizung abschalten. In diesem Fall blinkt die Kontrolleuchte im Schalter. Ist wieder genügend Spannung vorhanden, schaltet sich die Heckscheibenheizung selbsttätig wieder ein."

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p67_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz technical manual or owner's guide, specifically covering the operation of the electric power windows (Fensterheber elektrisch) for a vehicle such as the R129 SL-Class.

### Components and Icons
*   **Electric Window Switch (Fensterheber Schalter):** Illustrated in the top left. It is a rocker-style switch with two distinct icons:
    *   **Upward-pointing arrow icon:** Represents the command to close the window (**schließen**).
    *   **Downward-pointing arrow icon:** Represents the command to open the window (**öffnen**).
*   **Diagram Reference Number:** Located just below the switch illustration: **P67-0001-B13**.

### Text and Instructions
The document is divided into several sections of instructional text:

**Header and Location:**
*   **Fensterheber elektrisch** (Electric power windows)
*   **Die Schalter befinden sich auf der Mittelkonsole.** (The switches are located on the center console.)
*   **Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2 (bei einer geöffneten Tür auch bei Schlüsselstellung 1 oder 0 oder bei abgezogenem Schlüssel).** (Key in the steering lock in position 2; if a door is open, also in key position 1 or 0, or with the key removed.)

**Operating Instructions:**
*   **Schalter bis zum Druckpunkt betätigen:** (Operate the switch up to the pressure point:)
    *   [Up Arrow Icon] **schließen** (close)
    *   [Down Arrow Icon] **öffnen** (open)
*   **Schalter loslassen, wenn die gewünschte Stellung der Scheibe erreicht ist.** (Release the switch when the desired window position is reached.)
*   **Schalter über den Druckpunkt hinweg auf [Down Arrow Icon] drücken und loslassen – die Scheibe gleitet in die unterste Stellung. Zum Unterbrechen des Vorganges den Schalter auf [Down Arrow Icon] oder [Up Arrow Icon] kurz antippen.** (Press the switch past the pressure point to [Down Arrow Icon] and release – the window slides to the lowest position. To interrupt the process, briefly tap the switch to [Down Arrow Icon] or [Up Arrow Icon].) This describes the "auto-down" feature.

**Notes and Warnings:**
*   **Hinweis: Wird das Fahrzeug längere Zeit mit einer geöffneten Tür abgestellt, kann sich die Batterie entladen.** (Note: If the vehicle is parked for a long time with a door open, the battery can discharge.)
*   **Achtung! Gefährdung mitfahrender Kinder vermeiden – auch bei kurzzeitigem Verlassen des Fahrzeuges den Schlüssel abziehen.** (Attention! Avoid danger to children traveling with you – remove the key even when leaving the vehicle for a short time.)
*   **Achtung! Beim Schließen der Seitenscheiben darauf achten, daß niemand durch Einklemmen verletzt wird.** (Attention! When closing the side windows, ensure that no one is injured by being trapped.)

### Layout Details
*   **Page Number:** **65** is visible at the bottom right corner.
*   **Section Label:** A vertical red bar on the right edge contains the word **Bedienung** (Operation), indicating this page is part of the "Operation" section of the manual.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p68_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz technical service or owner's manual (page 66) detailing the operation and safety instructions for the automatic roll bar (Überrollbügel) system, specifically for the R129 SL-Class.

### 1. Components and Reference Numbers
*   **Roll Bar Switch (Überrollbügel-Schalter):** Shown in an illustration at the top left. It is a dual-rocker switch located in the center console.
    *   **Upper Icon:** A roll bar with an upward-pointing arrow.
    *   **Lower Icon:** A roll bar with a downward-pointing arrow.
*   **Reference Number:** Below the illustration is the image identifier `P91.0001-013`.
*   **Roll Bar (Überrollbügel):** The mechanical safety component described in the text.
*   **Instrument Cluster (Kombi-Instrument):** Mentioned as the location for the system warning light.

### 2. Operational Instructions and Measurements
*   **Manual Operation:**
    *   Requires the ignition key to be in **Position 2**.
    *   **Press Top:** Raises (aufstellen) the roll bar.
    *   **Press Bottom:** Lowers (abklappen) the roll bar.
*   **Automatic Deployment Reset:** If the roll bar deploys automatically (accompanied by a ratcheting noise), it must be reset.
    *   **Measurement:** Press and hold the top of the switch for **at least 5 seconds (mindestens 5 Sekunden)** until the drive audibly engages before it can be lowered.
*   **Safety Recommendations:**
    *   The roll bar should be kept raised if temperatures are **lower than -15 °C**.
    *   The roll bar should be raised if passengers or animals are in the rear while the vehicle is closed.

### 3. Safety and Diagnostic Information
*   **Warning (Achtung!):** Ensure the movement area is clear to avoid injury. Releasing the switch immediately stops the movement.
*   **Fault Detection:** A defect is present if:
    *   Control lights in the switch flash.
    *   The roll bar warning light in the instrument cluster illuminates.
*   **Emergency Procedure:** If a defect is detected, drive with the roll bar in the raised position until repaired. Pressing the top of the switch will extinguish the switch lights, though the instrument cluster warning light will remain on.

### 4. Visible Text Transcription (German)
*   **Main Heading:** Überrollbügel
*   **Left Column:**
    *   Der Schalter befindet sich in der Mittelkonsole.
    *   Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2.
    *   Schalter drücken oben = aufstellen, unten = abklappen.
    *   Wurde der Überrollbügel mit dem Schalter aufgestellt, wird er bei Betätigung des Verdeckschalters automatisch abgeklappt.
*   **Center Column:**
    *   Der Überrollbügel wird bei einem Unfall oder bei einer kritischen Fahrsituation automatisch aufgestellt. Dies macht sich durch ein ratschendes Geräusch bemerkbar.
    *   Nach einem automatischen Aufstellen kann der Überrollbügel wieder abgeklappt werden: Dazu den Schalter zunächst solange oben drücken (mindestens 5 Sekunden), bis der Überrollbügelantrieb hörbar einrastet. Dann den Schalter unten drücken – der Überrollbügel wird abgeklappt.
    *   Mit aufgestelltem Überrollbügel fahren: Bei tieferen Temperaturen als -15 °C. Wenn bei geschlossenem Fahrzeug im Fond Personen oder Tiere mitfahren.
    *   Im Fond mitgeführte Gegenstände so anordnen, daß die Aufstellbewegung des Überrollbügels nicht beeinträchtigt wird.
*   **Right Column:**
    *   **Achtung!** Vor und während der Betätigung des Überrollbügel-Schalters darauf achten, daß der Bewegungsraum des Überrollbügels frei ist...
    *   Bei Gefahr den Schalter loslassen – der Bewegungsablauf des Überrollbügels ist sofort unterbrochen.
    *   **Hinweise:** Blinken die Kontrolleuchten im Schalter und leuchtet die Überrollbügel-Warnleuchte im Kombi-Instrument auf, liegt ein Defekt vor.
    *   Anlage in einer Mercedes-Benz Service-Station überprüfen lassen.
    *   Aus Sicherheitsgründen nur mit aufgestelltem Überrollbügel fahren, bis der Defekt behoben ist. Dazu den Schalter oben drücken – die Kontrolleuchten im Schalter erlöschen, die Warnleuchte im Kombi-Instrument jedoch nicht.

This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual (page 67) detailing the procedure for removing the Coupe-Dach (hardtop).

### **Overview**
The document provides instructions for removing the hardtop, emphasizing safety and correct sequencing of mechanical and electrical steps.

### **Components & Callouts**
*   **Component 1 (Image P82-0021-01T):** **Steckverbindung** (Electrical connector) for the heated rear window. It is located on the rear side panel/B-pillar area inside the cabin.
*   **Component 2 (Image P82-0016-01T):** **Verdeckschalter** (Soft top/Hardtop switch) located on the center console. A red arrow indicates pressing the switch backward to initiate the unlocking process.
*   **Überrollbügel:** (Roll bar) Mentioned as part of the automated process.
*   **Kontrolleuchte:** (Indicator lamp) Built into the top switch (2).

### **Procedural Steps (Dach abnehmen - Removing the roof)**
1.  **Parking Brake:** Engage the parking brake (*Feststellbremse betätigen*).
2.  **Doors:** Open the doors (*Türen öffnen*).
3.  **Electrical Connection:** Disconnect the plug **(1)** for the heated rear window.
4.  **Ignition:** Turn the key in the steering lock to **Position 2**.
5.  **Switch Operation:** Within 10 seconds of turning the key, press the top switch **(2)** backward and hold it.

### **System Response**
After approximately **2 seconds**, the unlocking process begins:
*   The roll bar is automatically lowered/folded down.
*   The indicator lamp in the top switch lights up.
*   The hardtop is electronically unlocked from the vehicle body.

### **Visible Text**
*   **Main Title:** Coupé-Dach (red text)
*   **Introductory Text:** Notes that removal and installation are best done with a specialized hoist (available at Mercedes-Benz service stations) but can be done by two people without it.
*   **Warning (Achtung!):** Ensure no one is injured by pinching/trapping before operating the switch.
*   **Side Margin:** "Bedienung" (Operation) on a red vertical bar.
*   **Technical Codes:** P82-0021-01T (left image) and P82-0016-01T (right image).
*   **Page Number:** 67 (bottom right).

### **Measurements & Technical Specs**
*   **Time limit:** Action must be taken within **10 seconds** of turning the ignition.
*   **Delay:** **2 seconds** hold-time before the mechanical unlocking starts.
*   **Ignition Setting:** **Position 2** (On/Run position).
