This image is an instructional technical diagram from a Mercedes-Benz service or owner's manual (specifically for the R129 SL-Class), detailing the procedure for removing the hardtop roof.

### **Components and Labels**
*   **3 (Red):** Points to the **Befestigungspunkten** (attachment points). There are two locations shown:
    *   One at the front-top corner where the hardtop connects to the top of the windshield frame (A-pillar).
    *   One at the bottom-rear corner where the hardtop meets the vehicle body.
*   **4 (Red):** Points to the **Fixierpunkten** (fixing points) located along the lower side edge of the hardtop, above the area of the door handle.
*   **P65-0083-023:** Identification number for the illustration, located near the rear wheel.

### **Connections**
The diagram illustrates the physical contact and locking points between the removable hardtop roof and the main body of the car. The points labeled **3** and **4** are where the roof must be disengaged and lifted from.

### **Visible Text**
*   **Hinweis (Note - top right):** "Wir empfehlen, das Dach in einem speziellen Behälter aufzubewahren. Er ist in jeder Mercedes-Benz Service-Station erhältlich." (Note: We recommend storing the roof in a special container. It is available at every Mercedes-Benz service station.)
*   **Instruction 6 (bottom left):** "6. Aus Sicherheitsgründen nach dem Entriegeln den Lenkschloßschlüssel abziehen. Die Kontrolleuchte im Verdeckschalter erlischt." (6. For safety reasons, remove the ignition key after unlocking. The indicator light in the convertible top switch goes out.)
*   **Instruction 7 (bottom center):** "7. Das Dach senkrecht aus den Befestigungspunkten (3) und den Fixierpunkten (4) heben und vorsichtig nach hinten abnehmen - Gefahr von Lackbeschädigungen." (7. Lift the roof vertically out of the attachment points (3) and the fixing points (4) and carefully remove it towards the rear - risk of paint damage.)
*   **Page Number:** "68" is visible in the bottom left corner.

*   **Measurements:** No numerical measurements are provided.
*   **Part Numbers:** No specific part numbers for components are listed, only the illustration ID.

This is a technical instruction page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual, detailing the process for installing the removable hardtop ("Dach aufsetzen").

### **General Layout**
*   **Page Number:** 69 (bottom right).
*   **Section Title (Vertical Red Tab):** "Bedienung" (Operation).
*   **Main Heading:** "Dach aufsetzen" (Mounting the roof).
*   **Illustrations:** Two black-and-white diagrams.
    *   **Left Image:** A side profile of the vehicle showing the hardtop being positioned.
    *   **Right Image:** A top-down view of the soft top/hardtop control switch on the center console.

### **Components and Labels**
#### **Left Diagram (Image Code: P55-6014-B23)**
*   **1 (Front):** Indicates the front attachment point where the hardtop meets the windshield frame (A-pillar).
*   **1 (Rear):** Indicates the rear mounting point on the car body near the rear deck.
*   **2:** Indicates the fixing point at the side window/B-pillar area where the hardtop aligns.
*   **Hardtop:** The removable metal roof being placed onto the car.

#### **Right Diagram (Image Code: P55-0008-B13B)**
*   **3:** Indicates the soft top/hardtop control switch.
*   **Red Arrow:** Points toward the front of the vehicle, indicating the direction to push the switch to lock the roof.

### **Instructional Text (Translated from German)**
The text provides a step-by-step procedure:

1.  **Feststellbremse betätigen:** Engage the parking brake.
2.  **Überrollbügel abklappen, siehe Seite 66:** Fold down the roll bar (refer to page 66).
3.  **Türen öffnen:** Open the doors.
4.  **Aus Sicherheitsgründen den Lenkschloßschlüssel abziehen:** For safety reasons, remove the ignition key.
5.  **Das Dach vorsichtig vom Fahrzeugheck her über die Befestigungspunkte (1) und die Fixierpunkte (2) heben. Zuerst die hinteren Zapfen des Daches senkrecht in die hinteren Befestigungspunkte einführen, dann das Dach vorsichtig aufsetzen – Gefahr von Lackbeschädigungen:** Carefully lift the roof from the rear of the vehicle over attachment points (1) and fixing points (2). First, insert the rear pins of the roof vertically into the rear attachment points, then carefully set the roof down—risk of paint damage.
6.  **Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2. Die Kontrolleuchte im Verdeckschalter leuchtet auf:** Turn the key in the ignition to position 2. The indicator light in the roof switch will light up.
7.  **Verdeckschalter nach vorn drücken (3) – das Dach wird verriegelt und die Kontrolleuchte im Verdeckschalter erlischt:** Press the roof switch forward (3)—the roof will be locked electronically, and the indicator light in the switch will turn off.

### **Technical Details**
*   **Part Numbers/Wire Colors:** No specific part numbers or wire colors are provided in this excerpt.
*   **Image Codes:** `P55-6014-B23` and `P55-0008-B13B` are located at the bottom right of each illustration.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p72_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual, specifically focusing on the soft top operation and its electrical connection.

### **Image Description**
The image features a black-and-white photograph on the top left showing a section of the car's interior behind the B-pillar and seat. A red number **"4"** points to an electrical plug-in connector located near the side upholstery and the soft top storage compartment.

*   **Reference Code:** A small code, **"P80-0027-11S"**, is visible at the bottom right corner of the photograph.

### **Technical Details**
*   **Component Name:** Connector (labeled **4**) for the heated rear window (heizbare Heckscheibe).
*   **Connection:** This is the manual electrical plug connection that must be joined to power the defroster element in the soft top's rear window.
*   **Measurements/Part Numbers/Wire Colors:** None are explicitly listed in this specific document snippet.

### **Text Content (German and Translation)**

**Instructional Text (Left):**
*   **German:** "8. Steckverbindung (4) zur heizbaren Heckscheibe herstellen."
*   **Translation:** 8. Establish plug connection (4) to the heated rear window.

**Warning Section (Middle):**
*   **Heading:** "Achtung! Das Dach ist nicht verriegelt," (Attention! The roof is not locked,)
*   **Condition 1:** "wenn die Kontrolleuchte im Verdeckschalter nicht erlischt (Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2)." (if the indicator light in the soft top switch does not go out [key in ignition lock in position 2].)
*   **Condition 2:** "wenn die Kontrolleuchte beim Anfahren blinkt und gleichzeitig ein Gong ertönt." (if the indicator light flashes when starting to drive and a chime sounds at the same time.)
*   **Action:** "Vor der Weiterfahrt das Dach verriegeln: Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2. Verdeckschalter nach vorn drücken." (Before continuing the journey, lock the roof: Key in ignition lock in position 2. Push soft top switch forward.)

**Notes Section (Right):**
*   **Heading:** "Hinweise: Aus Sicherheitsgründen kann das Dach nicht entriegelt werden:" (Notes: For safety reasons, the roof cannot be unlocked:)
*   **Restriction 1:** "10 Sekunden nach dem Drehen des Schlüssels im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2," (10 seconds after turning the key in the ignition lock to position 2,)
*   **Restriction 2:** "während der Fahrt." (while driving.)
*   **Troubleshooting:** "Blinkt während der Betätigung des Verdeckschalters die Kontrolleuchte... kann die Batteriespannung zu gering sein - Motor laufen lassen." (If the indicator light flashes during operation... battery voltage may be too low - leave engine running.)
*   **Mechanical Backup:** "Blinkt die Kontrolleuchte weiter, das Dach mechanisch verriegeln. Siehe Seite 132." (If the indicator light continues to flash, lock the roof mechanically. See page 132.)
*   **Service:** "Anlage in einer Mercedes-Benz Service-Station überprüfen lassen." (Have the system checked at a Mercedes-Benz service station.)

**Page Number:**
*   **70** (visible at the bottom left).

This image is page 71 from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 service document or owner's manual, titled "**Roadster-Verdeck**" (Roadster soft top). It details the operation and safety precautions for the convertible top.

### **Technical Diagram Details**
*   **Component:** The central diagram shows the convertible top control switch located on the center console.
*   **Switch Graphic:** The switch features a stylized icon of a car with a folding top.
*   **Directional Indicator:** A large red arrow, labeled with a white number "**1**", points towards the rear (downward in the diagram's perspective), indicating the direction to push the switch to open the top.
*   **Reference Number:** Small text below the diagram reads "**M 77-0067-11/1A**".

### **Textual Content and Instructions**

#### **Safety and Conditions**
*   **Space Requirements:** Sufficient clearance is required above the top for opening and closing.
*   **Temperature Restrictions:** The top must not be operated if the fabric is frozen or if the temperature is below **-15 °C**.
*   **Achtung! (Warning):** Before and during operation, ensure the movement area for the roll bar (**Überrollbügel**), top compartment lid (**Verdeckkastendeckel**), and top linkage (**Verdeckgestänge**) is clear of people and objects. Releasing the switch immediately stops the process.

#### **Opening the Top (Verdeck öffnen)**
The manual lists a three-step procedure:
1.  **Feststellbremse betätigen:** Engage the parking brake.
2.  **Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2:** Turn the ignition key to position 2.
3.  **Verdeckschalter nach hinten drücken (1) und festhalten:** Press the top switch backwards (direction 1) and hold it.

**Automatic Sequence during step 3:**
*   Side windows (**Seitenscheiben**) are lowered.
*   The roll bar (**Überrollbügel**) is folded down.
*   An indicator light in the top switch illuminates.
*   The soft top is stowed in the top compartment (**Verdeckkasten**).
*   The top compartment lid is closed and locked.
*   The indicator light goes out when the process is complete.

#### **Additional Information**
*   **Window and Roll Bar Control:** If the switch is held or pressed again within approximately **2 seconds** after the top is stowed, the side windows will close and a previously raised roll bar will be raised again. They can also be operated with their own independent switches.
*   **Hinweis (Note):** The top must be dry before being stowed in the compartment.

### **Document Markers**
*   **Section Label:** "**Bedienung**" (Operation) is printed vertically on a red tab on the right edge.
*   **Page Number:** "**71**" is located in the bottom right corner.

This technical document is page 72 from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's or service manual, detailing the procedure for closing the power soft top ("Verdeck schließen").

### **Diagrams and Illustrations**

*   **Left Illustration (Switch Operation):**
    *   **Component:** A top-down view of the soft top operation switch located on the center console.
    *   **Callout (2):** A red arrow pointing forward indicates the direction to push and hold the switch to initiate the closing sequence.
    *   **Reference Number:** Small text "P77.0006-8136" is located below the frame.

*   **Right Illustration (Windshield Header):**
    *   **Components:** Shows the upper interior area of the windshield, including the rearview mirror, sun visors (in the folded-down position), and the overhead control panel.
    *   **Callout (3):** A red number "3" points to the center recessed grip area (Griffschale) in the upper windshield frame header. This is used to manually assist the top pins into their locks if they do not seat automatically.
    *   **Reference Number:** Small text "P77.0004-8134" is located at the bottom right of the image.

### **Instructional Text (Translated Summary)**

**Verdeck schließen (Closing the top):**
1.  **Feststellbremse betätigen:** Apply the parking brake.
2.  **Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2:** Turn the ignition key to position 2.
3.  **Hochgestellte Sonnenblenden abklappen:** Fold down any raised sun visors.
4.  **Verdeckschalter nach vorn drücken (2) und festhalten:** Push the soft top switch forward (2) and hold it.

**Sequence of Operation:**
*   Side windows are lowered.
*   The roll bar (if raised) is folded down.
*   The indicator light in the switch illuminates.
*   The soft top closes and locks.
*   The indicator light goes out, signaling the process is complete.

**Note (Hinweis):**
The text explains that if the top does not automatically engage with the mounting points on the upper windshield frame, the user should release the switch, use the **grip (3)** to manually guide the pins into the locks, and then push the **switch forward (2)** again to complete the locking. It also notes that holding the switch after the top is closed, or releasing and re-pressing it within 2 seconds, will raise the side windows and restore the roll bar to its previous position.

### **Document Details**
*   **Page Number:** 72 (bottom left corner).
*   **Language:** German.
*   **Model Context:** Mercedes-Benz R129 SL-Class.

text:
[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p75_img1.jpeg]
This image is a technical information page (page 73) from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically from the "**Bedienung**" (Operation) section. It contains instructions and warnings regarding the power convertible top (Verdeck) operation.

### **Text Content and Instructions**

**Left Column: Warnings and Immediate Action**
*   **Achtung! (Attention!):** States that the soft top is not locked if:
    *   The indicator light in the soft top switch does not go out (with the key in ignition position 2).
    *   The indicator light flashes when driving off and a warning chime (gong) sounds simultaneously.
*   **Action to take:** Lock the soft top before continuing to drive by:
    1.  Putting the key in the steering lock in **Stellung 2** (Position 2).
    2.  Pressing the soft top switch forward.
*   **Safety Warning:** An unlocked top can flip forward or backward upon starting. Do not reach into the top linkage, the upper windshield frame, or the top storage compartment due to the risk of injury.

**Middle Column: Operational Safety and Troubleshooting**
*   **Safety Lock:** For safety, the top cannot be unlocked while the vehicle is in motion. However, if it was not fully locked, it can be locked while driving.
*   **Indicator Light Flashing:** If the light flashes during operation, it may indicate:
    *   Low battery voltage: Keep the engine running.
    *   Drive overload: Occurs after approx. **5 consecutive operations**. Operation will be possible again after a rest period of approx. **2 minutes**.
*   **Further Action:** If the light continues to flash, lock the top manually (referencing **page 129**) and have the system checked at a Mercedes-Benz service station.

**Right Column: Additional Notes (Hinweise)**
*   **Roll Bar Interaction:** If the automatic roll bar has deployed, hold the soft top switch until the opening or closing cycle begins.
*   **Material Care:** Warns that prolonged sunlight degrades fabric, color, and rubber.
*   **Storage Advice:** If the top stays in the compartment for too long, it can become musty/moldy. It is recommended to remove the "Coupé-Dach" (hardtop) several times a year, especially in winter, to exercise and ventilate the soft top with the side windows open.

### **Components Mentioned**
*   **Verdeck:** Soft top / Convertible top
*   **Verdeckschalter:** Soft top switch
*   **Kontrolleuchte:** Indicator/warning light (integrated into the switch)
*   **Lenkschloß:** Steering lock / ignition switch
*   **Verdeckgestänge:** Soft top frame/linkage
*   **Windschutzoberteil:** Upper windshield frame/header
*   **Verdeckkasten:** Soft top storage compartment
*   **Antrieb:** Drive/motor mechanism
*   **Überrollbügel:** Roll bar
*   **Coupé-Dach:** Hardtop / Coupé roof
*   **Seitenscheiben:** Side windows

### **Measurements and Values**
*   **Stellung 2:** Ignition key position 2.
*   **ca. 5 Betätigungen:** Approximately 5 operations (thermal limit for the drive).
*   **ca. 2 Minuten:** Approximately 2-minute cooling period.
*   **Seite 129:** Cross-reference for manual locking instructions.
*   **73:** Page number.

### **Visual Elements**
*   **Red Margin Bar:** Located on the right edge, containing the word "**Bedienung**" rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
*   There are no specific part numbers or wire colors visible on this page. No graphical diagrams are present; the technical information is delivered entirely through text.

This technical document from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual details the installation of a wind deflector (Windschott).

### Document Overview
*   **Topic:** Windschott (Wind Deflector)
*   **Action:** Einbauen (Installation)
*   **Page Number:** 74

### Visible Components and Labels
The document uses numbered labels (1-4) in red circles/squares and corresponding red arrows to indicate parts and movement:
*   **1:** **Windschott (Wind Deflector)** - Shown being pushed upwards into the roll bar frame.
*   **2:** **Befestigungsbänder (Fastening straps)** - Located at the upper left and right corners of the wind deflector frame.
*   **3:** **Buckle mechanism** - Shown in a close-up view where the fastening strap buckle is being connected.
*   **4:** **Strap end** - Indicated as the part to pull to provide tension.
*   **Überrollbügel (Roll bar):** The structural frame that houses the wind deflector.

### Technical Instructions (Translated from German)
1.  **Raise the roll bar slightly** by pressing the switch on the dashboard.
2.  **Insert the wind deflector** into the roll bar. Start by placing one side at the bottom and sliding the hook under the roll bar, then lower the other side into place.
3.  **Slide the wind deflector upwards (1)** into the roll bar frame, ensuring the fastening straps (2) are not jammed.
4.  **Raise the roll bar completely.**
5.  **Secure the wind deflector** to the roll bar using the fastening straps and buckles (3).
6.  **Tension the fastening straps (4)** by pulling on the loose ends.
7.  **Fold down the roll bar.**

### Image Reference Codes
*   **Left illustration:** P86-0013-213
*   **Right illustration:** P86-0014-213

text:
[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p77_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical instruction page from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 (SL-Class) owner's manual ("Bedienung") detailing the operation of the wind deflector (**Windschott**).

### Page Layout and General Information
*   **Page Number:** 75 (bottom right corner).
*   **Document Context:** The vertical red bar on the right side contains the text "Bedienung," indicating it is from the "Operation" or "User Manual" section.
*   **Illustration Codes:** Each diagram has an internal figure code: **P85-0015-813** (left), **P85-0017-813** (middle), and **P85-0016-813** (right).

---

### Component Names and Descriptions
1.  **Windschott (Wind Deflector):** A black mesh screen assembly placed behind the front seats to reduce wind turbulence.
2.  **Oberteil des Windschotts (Upper Part):** The hinged mesh frame that can be raised vertically or folded down.
3.  **Kopfstützen (Headrests):** The front seat headrests used as a physical stop for the raised wind deflector.
4.  **Überrollbügel (Roll Bar):** The retractable safety bar behind the seats which houses the wind deflector assembly.
5.  **Befestigungsbänder (Fastening Straps):** Straps equipped with plastic buckles to secure the deflector.
6.  **Schloßzungen (Buckle Tongues):** The side-release mechanism on the plastic buckle.
7.  **Behälter (Storage Container/Bag):** Mentioned in text as an optional accessory for trunk storage.

---

### Step-by-Step Instructions

#### 1. Aufstellen (Set-up) - Left Image (P85-0015-813)
*   **Visual:** Shows the wind deflector being swung upward towards the front of the car. A red arrow indicates the direction of movement.
*   **Instruction:** "Oberteil des Windschotts bis zum Anschlag gegen die Kopfstützen schwenken." (Swing the top part of the wind deflector as far as it goes against the headrests.)
*   **Safety Warning:** "Achtung! Verletzungsgefahr! Sollen die Fondsitze besetzt werden, das Windschott abnehmen." (Caution! Risk of injury! If the rear seats are to be occupied, remove the wind deflector.)

#### 2. Ausbauen (Removal) - Middle & Right Images (P85-0017-813 & P85-0016-813)
*   **Middle Visual:** A close-up of the fastening buckle. Two inward-pointing red arrows indicate where to squeeze the "Schloßzungen" (buckle tongues) to release the strap.
*   **Right Visual:** Shows the deflector assembly inside the roll bar. A downward-pointing red arrow with the label "**5**" shows how to pull the unit down for removal.
*   **Instructions:**
    1.  "Oberteil des Windschotts abklappen." (Fold down the upper part of the wind deflector.)
    2.  "Überrollbügel aufstellen." (Raise the roll bar.)
    3.  "Steckverbindungen der Befestigungsbänder lösen. Dazu die Schloßzungen zusammendrücken." (Release the plug connections of the fastening straps. To do this, press the buckle tongues together.)
    4.  "Überrollbügel etwas abklappen." (Lower the roll bar slightly.)
    5.  "Windschott im Überrollbügel nach unten ziehen (5), zunächst auf einer Seite herausheben und dann vom Überrollbügel abnehmen." (Pull the wind deflector down in the roll bar (5), lift it out on one side first and then remove it from the roll bar.)

#### 3. Aufbewahren (Storage)
*   **Instruction:** "Das Windschott kann in einem Behälter aufbewahrt werden. Er ist in jeder Mercedes-Benz Service-Station erhältlich und kann im Kofferraum montiert werden." (The wind deflector can be stored in a container. It is available at any Mercedes-Benz service station and can be mounted in the trunk.)

This technical document from a Mercedes R129 service or owner's manual illustrates the operation and display of the **Reiserechner** (Trip Computer).

### Components and Controls

*   **Keyboard (Tastatur):** A square control panel (bottom-right image reference **P82-0059-B13**) featuring eight buttons:
    *   **Top Row (Function Keys):** "Limit", "Start", "Ziel" (Destination), and "K / L" (Memory toggle).
    *   **Bottom Row (Numerical Input Keys):** "1000", "100", "10", and "1".
*   **Display Unit:** A motorized flip-up screen located above the central dashboard air vents (bottom-right image reference **P82-0058-B34B**).
*   **Opening Button:** Indicated by a red number **"1"** located to the right of the air vents, used to open the display compartment.
*   **Ignition Lock Symbol:** Located below the opening button.

### Display Data
The display in the diagram shows the following information:
*   **Top Left:** "AB START" / "345 km" (Distance since start)
*   **Top Right:** "3:20 h" (Travel time)
*   **Bottom Left:** "K" (Short-trip memory indicator) / "103 km/h" (Average speed)
*   **Bottom Right:** "13,5 l/100 km" (Average fuel consumption)

### Text and Instructions (Translated/Transcribed)

**Heading: Reiserechner (Trip Computer)**

**Tastatur (Keyboard)**
*   **3 Funktionstasten (3 Function keys):** Limit, Start, Ziel.
*   **Umschalttaste (Toggle key):**
    *   K = Kurzstreckenspeicher (Short-trip memory)
    *   L = Langstreckenspeicher (Long-trip memory)
*   **4 Tasten für Ziffern-Eingabe:** (4 keys for numerical input)

**Display**
*   **Displayfach öffnen (Open display compartment):** Taste 1 drücken (Press button 1).
*   **Displayfach geschlossen (Display compartment closed):** Berechnung der Daten läuft intern weiter (Calculation of data continues internally).
*   **Limit-Geschwindigkeit wird weiterhin überwacht** (Limit speed continues to be monitored).

**Einschalten (Switching On)**
*   Schlüssel im Lenkschloß in Stellung 2 drehen (Turn key in steering lock to position 2).
*   Auf dem Display erscheint der Funktionsblock „AB START“ und das „K“ für Kurzstreckenspeicher (The function block "AB START" and the "K" for short-trip memory appear on the display).

**Reference Numbers and Pagination:**
*   **Page Number:** 76
*   **Image References:** P82-0059-B13 (Keyboard), P82-0058-B34B (Dashboard/Display).

This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz vehicle owner's manual (specifically for the R129 series) describing the "Limit-Funktion" (speed limit function) of the on-board computer.

### Graphical Components:
*   **Button Pad (Left):** A 2x4 grid of buttons for operating the on-board computer.
    *   Top row: **Limit** (with a red arrow pointing down to it), **Start**, **Ziel**, **K/L**.
    *   Bottom row: **1000**, **100**, **10**, **1**.
    *   Technical identification number below the pad: **P82-0031-811**.
*   **Digital Display (Right):** A rectangular box representing the dashboard display showing:
    *   The word "**LIMIT**" on the left.
    *   A small "**1**" above a larger "**100 km/h**".
    *   Technical identification number below the display: **P82-0032-831A**.
*   **Right margin:** A red vertical bar with the word "**Bedienung**" (Operation) written vertically.
*   **Page Number:** "**77**" is in the bottom right corner.

### Text Transcription and Translation of Sections:

#### Limit-Funktion (Limit Function)
*   **1 Limit-Geschwindigkeit (programmierbar)** - 1 Speed limit (programmable)
*   Die Limit-Funktion bewirkt eine optische und akustische Warnung, wenn die eingegebene Geschwindigkeit überschritten wird. (The limit function causes a visual and acoustic warning when the entered speed is exceeded.)

#### Eingabe: (Input:)
*   **Taste [Limit] drücken, bis Piepton ertönt.** (Press the [Limit] button until a beep sounds.)
*   **Ziffern eingeben mit den Tasten [100], [10] und [1].** (Enter digits with the buttons [100], [10] and [1].)
*   **Eingabe bestätigen: Taste [Limit] kurz drücken.** (Confirm entry: Briefly press the [Limit] button.)
*   **Hinweis: Bei eingegebener Limit-Geschwindigkeit unter 10 km/h erfolgt kein Alarm.** (Note: If the entered limit speed is below 10 km/h, no alarm will occur.)

#### Alarm:
*   **Warnung durch Gongtöne für ca. 4 Sekunden und Anzeige auf dem Display, wenn Limit-Geschwindigkeit überschritten wird.** (Warning by chime tones for approx. 4 seconds and a message on the display when the limit speed is exceeded.)
*   **Alarm sperren: Beliebige Taste während des Alarms drücken.** (Mute alarm: Press any button during the alarm.)
*   **Sperre aufheben: Taste [Limit] kurz drücken.** (Cancel mute: Briefly press the [Limit] button.)
*   **Hinweis: Wird nach Fahrzeugstillstand der Schlüssel im Lenkschloß eingesteckt, ist der Alarm wieder aktiviert.** (Note: If the key is inserted into the steering lock after the vehicle has come to a standstill, the alarm is activated again.)

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p80_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or operator's manual, specifically detailing the operation of the trip computer (**Bordcomputer**). 

### **Component Overview**
The diagram consists of two main visual elements and associated instructional text:

1.  **Control Keypad (Left Graphic):**
    *   An 8-button interface used to interact with the trip computer.
    *   **Top Row Buttons:** `Limit`, `Start` (indicated with a red arrow), `Ziel` (Destination), and `K/L` (Short-term/Long-term memory toggle).
    *   **Bottom Row Buttons:** Numeric input buttons labeled `1000`, `100`, `10`, and `1`.
    *   **Reference Number:** `P82-0033-R11` is printed below the keypad.

2.  **Digital Display Screen (Right Graphic):**
    *   Shows real-time trip data with numerical indicators corresponding to the text below.
    *   **AB START:** Indicates the data shown is "from start."
    *   **Indicator 1 (Red 1):** Distance from start — `345 km`.
    *   **Indicator 2 (Red 2):** Time elapsed from start — `3:20 h`.
    *   **Indicator 3 (Red 3):** Average speed — `103 km/h`.
    *   **Indicator 4 (Red 4):** Average fuel consumption — `13,5 l/100 km`.
    *   **Indicator 5 (Red 5):** Memory status — `K` (Short-term memory).
    *   **Reference Number:** `P82-0034-B31A` is printed below the display.

---

### **Text and Instructions**

The text is organized into three columns, translated and summarized as follows:

**Column 1: Start-Funktion (Start Function)**
*   **Definitions for Red Indicators (1-5):**
    1.  **Weg ab Start:** Distance from start.
    2.  **Zeit ab Start:** Time from start.
    3.  **Durchschnittsgeschwindigkeit:** Average speed.
    4.  **Durchschnittsverbrauch:** Average fuel consumption.
    5.  **Kurzstreckenspeicher:** Short-term trip memory.
*   **Memory Info:** States there are two independent memories for calculation. Use the `K/L` button to toggle between short-term (Kurz) and long-term (Lang) memory.

**Column 2: Löschen (Resetting)**
*   Resetting is possible for both "K" and "L" memories.
*   **Procedure:** Press and hold the `Start` button until an acoustic beep sounds.
*   **Hinweis (Note):** If the vehicle is stationary and the key is re-inserted into the ignition and turned to position 2, the short-term memory is deleted. In this case, "AB START" and "K" will flash on the display.

**Column 3: Hinweis (Note)**
*   The values from the last trip can be retained/adopted as long as "AB START" and "K" are flashing (up to a driving distance of 2 km).
*   **Procedure:** Briefly press the `Start` button to adopt the previous trip's values.

---

### **General Information**
*   **Page Number:** 78
*   **Language:** German
*   **Wire Colors:** None shown (this is a functional/user-interface diagram, not a wiring schematic).

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p81_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or operator's manual (page 79), specifically detailing the operation of the trip computer (Reiserechner).

### **1. Component Diagrams**

**Control Panel (Diagram P82-0036-811):**
This diagram shows the 8-button interface used to control the trip computer.
*   **Top Row Buttons:** `Limit`, `Start`, `Ziel` (Destination - highlighted with a red arrow), and `K/L` (Short-distance/Long-distance memory toggle).
*   **Bottom Row Buttons:** `1000`, `100`, `10`, and `1` (used for numerical data entry).

**LCD Display Screen (Diagram P82-0036-B31 A):**
The diagram illustrates the typical readout on the trip computer display.
*   **BIS ZIEL:** Indicates "To Destination."
*   **Data Fields:**
    *   **1:** `900 km` (Distance to destination).
    *   **2:** `22:45` (Estimated time of arrival at destination).
    *   **3:** `257 km` (Remaining fuel range, indicated by the fuel pump icon).
    *   **4:** `13,5 l/100km` (Average fuel consumption).
    *   **5:** `L 5` (Indicates Long-distance memory is active).

### **2. Textual Content and Instructions**

**Ziel-Funktion (Destination Function):**
The text lists the numbered display functions:
1.  **Weg bis Ziel (programmierbar):** Distance to destination (programmable).
2.  **Uhrzeit am Ziel:** Arrival time at destination.
3.  **Reichweite:** Fuel range.
4.  **Durchschnittsverbrauch:** Average fuel consumption.
5.  **Langstreckenspeicher:** Long-distance memory.
*   The document notes that two memories are available for destination distances. Short- and long-distance memories are selectable via the `K/L` button.

**Eingabe der Zielentfernung (Entering Destination Distance):**
*   Press and hold the `Ziel` button until a beep sounds.
*   Enter the distance digits using the `1000`, `100`, `10`, and `1` buttons.
*   Confirm the entry by briefly pressing the `Ziel` button.
*   **Note:** Resetting the average consumption can be done within the "Start" function.

**Uhrzeit (Time):**
*   The time is automatically displayed if the instrument cluster clock is adjusted.
*   The instrument cluster time is used to calculate the "Time at destination."
*   Example provided: If the cluster clock is set to 3:00 (PM), the display shows 15:00.
*   To hide the time display: Press the `Limit`, `Start`, or `Ziel` button.

### **3. Document Details**
*   **Reference Numbers:** `P82-0036-811` (Control panel) and `P82-0036-B31 A` (Display screen).
*   **Sidebar Text:** `Bedienung` (Operation).
*   **Page Number:** `79`.

This image is a page from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically page **82**. It details the operation of the parking brake and general starting/shifting advice.

### **Illustration Details**
The black-and-white illustration shows the driver's side footwell and lower dashboard area.
*   **Parking Brake Release Handle:** Located on the left side of the lower dashboard panel. It features a circular "(P)" parking brake symbol. A large red arrow points outwards from the handle, indicating the pulling motion required to release the brake.
*   **Parking Brake Pedal:** Located on the far left of the footwell floor. A large red arrow points downwards towards the pedal, indicating the pressing motion required to engage the brake.
*   **Other Visible Components:**
    *   Portion of the **steering wheel**.
    *   **Main brake pedal** (partially visible to the right of the parking brake pedal).
    *   **Side air vent** on the far left of the dashboard.
    *   **Diagram Reference Code:** Located at the bottom right corner of the illustration: **P42-0301-11**.

### **Technical Text (Transcribed from German)**

**Feststellbremse (Parking Brake)**
*   **Engagement:** "Pedal niedertreten. Die Bremsenkontrolleuchte leuchtet bei laufendem Motor auf." (Press pedal down. The brake control light illuminates when the engine is running.)
*   **Release:** "Lösen: Griff ziehen. Die Feststellbremse löst schlagartig. Die Bremsenkontrolleuchte erlischt bei laufendem Motor." (Release: Pull handle. The parking brake releases abruptly. The brake control light goes out when the engine is running.)
*   **Note:** "Hinweis: Leuchtet die Bremsenkontrolleuchte bei gelöster Feststellbremse und laufendem Motor weiterhin, siehe „Bremsenkontrolleuchte“, Seite 94." (Note: If the brake control light continues to illuminate with the parking brake released and the engine running, see "Brake control light", page 94.)

**Anfahren und Schalten (Starting and Shifting)**
This section provides several operational guidelines:
*   **Pedal Movement:** Ensuring floor mats or objects do not obstruct pedal travel.
*   **Brake Test:** Performing a test of the service brakes after starting to move.
*   **Warm-up:** Driving briskly to warm the motor, but not demanding full power until operating temperature is reached.
*   **Slippery Surfaces:** Avoid prolonged spinning of a single drive wheel on slippery ground, as this can damage the rear axle.

### **Summary of Technical Data**
*   **Measurements:** No numerical measurements are provided.
*   **Part Numbers:** No specific part numbers are listed, other than the illustration reference **P42-0301-11**.
*   **Wire Colors:** No wiring or electrical diagrams are present in this view.
*   **Page Number:** 82.

This image is a page from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically page 83. It describes the operation of manual and automatic transmissions.

### **Technical Diagrams**

There are two technical diagrams illustrating gear shift patterns for manual transmissions:

1.  **Left Diagram (Label: P26-0001-813A):**
    *   **Model:** 300 SL
    *   **Description:** Shows a traditional 5-speed manual gear shift pattern.
    *   **Shift Positions:**
        *   **R (Reverse):** Far left and down (indicated by a large red arrow).
        *   **1:** Far left and up.
        *   **2:** Middle and down.
        *   **3:** Middle and up.
        *   **4:** Right and down.
        *   **5:** Right and up.
    *   **Note:** The diagram shows the gear lever situated in a center console with surrounding buttons.

2.  **Right Diagram (Label: P26-0002-813):**
    *   **Model:** 300 SL-24
    *   **Description:** Shows a "dog-leg" 5-speed manual gear shift pattern.
    *   **Shift Positions:**
        *   **R (Reverse):** Far left and up.
        *   **1:** Far left and down (indicated by a large red arrow).
        *   **2:** Middle and up.
        *   **3:** Middle and down.
        *   **4:** Right and up.
        *   **5:** Right and down.

### **Visible Text (Translated from German)**

#### **Mechanisches Getriebe (Manual Transmission)**
*   **300 SL / 300 SL-24:** Refers to the models for each diagram.
*   **Schalthebelstellung in den einzelnen Gängen siehe Abbildung.** (Shift lever position in individual gears, see illustration.)
*   **Schalten in den Rückwärtsgang nur bei stillstehendem Fahrzeug. Dazu den Schalthebel anheben.** (Shift into reverse only when the vehicle is stationary. To do this, lift the gear lever.)
*   **Höchstgeschwindigkeit in den Gängen nicht überschreiten. Strichmarkierungen auf dem Geschwindigkeitsmesser beachten.** (Do not exceed the maximum speed in the gears. Note the line markings on the speedometer.)

#### **Parken (Parking)**
*   **Pedal der Feststellbremse niedertreten.** (Depress the parking brake pedal.)
*   **1. Gang oder Rückwärtsgang einlegen.** (Engage 1st gear or reverse gear.)
*   **An starken Steigungen oder Gefällen die Vorderräder gegen die Bordsteinkante drehen.** (On steep inclines or declines, turn the front wheels against the curb.)

#### **Automatisches Getriebe (Automatic Transmission)**
*   **Die einzelnen Gänge werden automatisch geschaltet, in Abhängigkeit von:** (The individual gears are switched automatically, depending on:)
    *   **Wählhebelstellung** (Selector lever position)
    *   **Programmwahlschalter-Stellung** (Program selector switch position)
    *   **Fahrpedalstellung** (Accelerator pedal position)
    *   **Fahrgeschwindigkeit** (Vehicle speed)

#### **Anfahren (Starting off)**
*   **Feststellbremse lösen. Betriebsbremse betätigen, damit die Wählhebelsperre aufgehoben wird.** (Release the parking brake. Apply the service brake so that the selector lever lock is released.)
*   **Wählhebel in eine Fahrstellung schalten. Motor im Leerlauf.** (Shift the selector lever to a driving position. Engine idling.)
*   **Betriebsbremse erst zum Anfahren lösen - sonst kann es sein, daß das Fahrzeug anrollt.** (Only release the service brake to start off - otherwise the vehicle may start rolling.)

### **Other Details**
*   **Vertical Tab:** A red vertical bar on the far right edge contains the word **"Fahren"** (Driving).
*   **Page Number:** **83** is located at the bottom right corner.
*   **Part/Reference Numbers:** Two technical illustration codes are present: **P26-0001-813A** and **P26-0002-813**.

This image is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically page 85, detailing the automatic transmission selector lever positions.

### Overview
The document is written in German and illustrates three different gear selector gate patterns for different transmission versions found in the R129 model.

### Component Illustrations
The top of the page features three black-and-white illustrations of the gear selector lever (Wählhebel):

1.  **Left Illustration:** Labeled **"Automatisches 4-Gang-Getriebe"** (Automatic 4-speed transmission).
    *   **Gate markings:** P, R, N, D, 3, 2.
    *   **Reference number:** 1431 (bottom right of the illustration).
2.  **Middle Illustration:** Labeled **"Automatisches 5-Gang-Getriebe"** (Automatic 5-speed transmission).
    *   **Gate markings:** P, R, N, D, 4, 3, 2.
    *   **Reference number:** P27-0008-B13A (below the illustration).
3.  **Right Illustration:** Labeled **"Automatisches Getriebe – 500 SL"** (Automatic transmission – 500 SL).
    *   **Gate markings:** P, R, N, D, 3, 2, B.
    *   **Reference number:** 1435 (bottom right of the illustration).

### Text and Measurements
There are no physical measurements or wire colors present, as this is an informational operating diagram.

#### Section: Wählhebelstellungen (Selector Lever Positions)

*   **P Parksperre (Park lock):**
    *   Description: Additional security when parking the vehicle. Only engage when the vehicle is stationary.
    *   **Hinweise (Notes):**
        *   When the steering lock key is removed, the selector lever is blocked in position "P".
        *   The steering lock key can only be removed in selector lever position "P".

*   **R Rückwärtsgang (Reverse gear):**
    *   Description: Only engage when the vehicle is stationary.

*   **N Leergang (Neutral):**
    *   Description: No power transmission from the engine to the drive wheels. With brakes released, the vehicle is free to move (pushing, towing). During driving, only shift to "N" if the vehicle is in danger of skidding (e.g., on winter ice, see page 15).

*   **D (Drive):**
    *   Description: All forward gears are available. For all normal driving situations.

### Additional Markings
*   **Sidebar:** A red vertical box on the right edge contains the word **"Fahren"** (Driving) rotated 90 degrees.
*   **Page Number:** **85** is printed at the bottom right corner.

This image is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual (page 86), written in German. It describes the operation of automatic transmission selector lever positions for special driving conditions.

### Visible Text and Information

**Main Heading:**
*   **Wählhebelstellungen für besondere Betriebssituationen:** (Selector lever positions for special operating situations)

**Left Column (Selector Positions):**
*   **4 (5-Gang-Automatik):** Hochschaltung nur bis zum 4. Gang. Für leistungsbetonte Fahrweise. (Upshifting only up to 4th gear. For performance-oriented driving.)
*   **3:** Hochschaltung nur bis zum 3. Gang. Für Fahrten auf mittleren Steigungen und Gefällen. In dieser Stellung kann die Bremswirkung des Motors ausgenutzt werden. (Upshifting only up to 3rd gear. For moderate inclines and descents. Engine braking can be utilized.)
*   **2:** Hochschaltung nur bis zum 2. Gang. Für Fahrten auf steilen Pässen, mit Anhänger im Gebirge, unter erschwerten Betriebsbedingungen sowie als Bremsstellung bei extremen Gefällen. (Upshifting only up to 2nd gear. For steep passes, mountain trailer towing, difficult conditions, or extreme descents.)

**Middle Column (Model Specific & Notes):**
*   **B (500 SL):** Bremsstellung bei extremen Gefällen und langen Paßabfahrten, insbesondere mit Anhänger. Unter **ca. 40 km/h** schaltet das Getriebe in den 1. Gang. Dieser bleibt bis **ca. 60 km/h** eingeschaltet. (Braking position for extreme descents/long passes. Below ~40 km/h it shifts to 1st gear, remaining until ~60 km/h.)
*   **Hinweise (Notes):**
    *   Höchstgeschwindigkeiten in den Wählhebelstellungen nicht überschreiten. Strichmarkierungen auf dem Geschwindigkeitsmesser beachten. (Do not exceed max speeds for selector positions. Observe dash markings on the speedometer.)
    *   Bei glatter Fahrbahn möglichst keine Bremsschaltung vornehmen. Dies gilt besonders für die Stellung B. (Avoid downshifting for braking on slippery roads, especially in position B.)

**Right Column (Transmission Types):**
*   **4-Gang-Automatik:** Only downshift if vehicle speed is not higher than the maximum permissible speed for the desired position to avoid engine damage from over-revving.
*   **5-Gang-Automatik:** The selector lever is locked for downshifts depending on speed to prevent excessive engine RPM.

### Components and Measurements
*   **Components Mentioned:** 4-Gang-Automatik (4-speed auto), 5-Gang-Automatik (5-speed auto), Wählhebel (selector lever), Getriebe (transmission), Motor (engine), Geschwindigkeitsmesser (speedometer).
*   **Measurements:** ca. 40 km/h, ca. 60 km/h.
*   **Page Number:** 86 (bottom left).

There are no wire colors, schematic connections, or specific part numbers visible in this text-based technical document.

### **Overview**
The document features three grayscale illustrations of gear selector gates, each with a corresponding program selector switch and descriptive German text.

### **Image 1: 4-Speed Automatic Transmission (Left)**
*   **Header:** Automatisches 4-Gang-Getriebe
*   **Gear Selector Gate:** Shows positions P, R, N, D, 3, 2. The selector lever is in the "P" (Park) position at the top of a gated track.
*   **Program Selector Switch:** A sliding switch next to the gate with positions "E" (Economy) and "S" (Standard). The "S" is circled in red.
*   **Reference Code:** 1006 (bottom right of the illustration).
*   **Text Summary:** 
    *   **S Standard:** Sliding the switch forward makes "S" visible. In selector positions "D" and "3", the vehicle starts in 2nd gear with light throttle and 1st gear with heavy throttle.

### **Image 2: 5-Speed Automatic Transmission (Center)**
*   **Header:** Automatisches 5-Gang-Getriebe
*   **Gear Selector Gate:** Shows positions P, R, N, D, 4, 3, 2. Note the "4" position next to "D". The selector lever is in the "P" position.
*   **Program Selector Switch:** A sliding switch with positions "E" and "S". The "E" is circled in red.
*   **Reference Code/Part Number:** P27-0007-813 (bottom right of the illustration).
*   **Text Summary:** 
    *   **E Economy:** Sliding the switch backward makes "E" visible. In positions "D", "4", and "3", the vehicle starts in 2nd gear even at full throttle. Upshifts and downshifts occur at lower vehicle speeds and engine RPMs compared to the "S" setting.

### **Image 3: 500 SL Automatic Transmission (Right)**
*   **Header:** Automatisches Getriebe – 500 SL
*   **Gear Selector Gate:** Shows positions P, R, N, D, 3, 2, B. The "B" (Braking) position is at the bottom. The selector lever is in the "P" position.

*   **Reference Code:** 1438 (bottom right of the illustration).
*   **Text Summary:**

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p90_img1.jpeg]
This is a technical page from a Mercedes-Benz owner's manual or service document, specifically detailing the operation of the **Tempomat (Cruise Control)** system for an R129 model.

### **Components and Diagram Overview**
The image features a diagram of the cruise control lever located on the steering column. Four red arrows indicate the directions in which the lever can be moved, each corresponding to a specific function numbered 1 through 4.

**Lever Labels:**
*   **AUS**: Off (indicated by arrow 3)
*   **SPEICHER**: Memory/Recall (indicated by arrow 4)
*   **BESCHL. FIX**: Accelerate / Set (indicated by arrow 1)
*   **VERZÖG. FIX**: Decelerate / Set (indicated by arrow 2)

### **Function Legend**
The text on the bottom left defines the four numbered movements:
1.  **Geschwindigkeit speichern (Schalter antippen)**: Save speed (tap switch up).
    **Beschleunigen (Schalter festhalten)**: Accelerate (hold switch up).
2.  **Geschwindigkeit speichern (Schalter antippen)**: Save speed (tap switch down).
    **Verzögern (Schalter festhalten)**: Decelerate (hold switch down).
3.  **Ausschalten (Geschwindigkeit bleibt gespeichert)**: Turn off (speed remains stored). This is achieved by pushing the lever away from the driver.
4.  **Gespeicherte Geschwindigkeit abrufen**: Recall stored speed. This is achieved by pulling the lever toward the driver.

### **Technical Specifications and Measurements**
*   **Minimum Operating Speed**: The system can be activated at any speed over approximately **40 km/h**.
*   **Speed Adjustment**: Tapping the switch in position 1 or 2 briefly increases or decreases the stored speed by **1 km/h**.
*   **Recall Threshold**: The stored speed can be recalled starting from approximately **40 km/h**.

### **Operating Instructions (Translated Summary)**
*   **Setting Speed**: Bring the vehicle to the desired speed and tap the lever up (1) or down (2). Release the accelerator pedal once the speed is stored.
*   **Deactivation**: Pressing the brake or clutch pedal automatically turns the cruise control off. Pushing the lever to position 3 turns it off while keeping the speed in memory.
*   **Memory Clear**: Turning the ignition key to position 1 or 0 clears the stored speed.
*   **Temporary Acceleration**: The driver can use the accelerator to speed up (e.g., for overtaking); the vehicle will return to the set speed once the pedal is released.
*   **Inclines/Declines**: On steep grades, the set speed might not be maintained. The system will regulate back to the set speed once the road levels out.

### **Missing Information**
*   **Part Numbers**: No specific part numbers are visible in this document.
*   **Wire Colors/Connections**: As this is an operator's guide rather than a wiring schematic, no wire colors or electrical connection points are shown beyond the physical mounting of the lever.
*   **Document Reference**: A small reference number is visible near the diagram: **P30-0254-13**.
*   **Page Number**: The page is numbered **88** at the bottom left.

2.  **Geschwindigkeit speichern (Schalter antippen)**: Save speed (tap switch down).
    **Verzögern (Schalter festhalten)**: Decelerate (hold switch down).
3.  **Ausschalten (Geschwindigkeit bleibt gespeichert)**: Turn off (speed remains stored). This is achieved by pushing the lever away from the driver.
4.  **Gespeicherte Geschwindigkeit abrufen**: Recall stored speed. This is achieved by pulling the lever toward the driver.

### **Technical Specifications and Measurements**
*   **Minimum Operating Speed**: The system can be activated at any speed over approximately **40 km/h**.
*   **Speed Adjustment**: Tapping the switch in position 1 or 2 briefly increases or decreases the stored speed by **1 km/h**.
*   **Recall Threshold**: The stored speed can be recalled starting from approximately **40 km/h**.

### **Operating Instructions (Translated Summary)**
*   **Setting Speed**: Bring the vehicle to the desired speed and tap the lever up (1) or down (2). Release the accelerator pedal once the speed is stored.
*   **Deactivation**: Pressing the brake or clutch pedal automatically turns the cruise control off. Pushing the lever to position 3 turns it off while keeping the speed in memory.
*   **Memory Clear**: Turning the ignition key to position 1 or 0 clears the stored speed.
*   **Temporary Acceleration**: The driver can use the accelerator to speed up (e.g., for overtaking); the vehicle will return to the set speed once the pedal is released.
*   **Inclines/Declines**: On steep grades, the set speed might not be maintained. The system will regulate back to the set speed once the road levels out.

*   **Part Numbers**: No specific part numbers are visible in this document.
*   **Wire Colors/Connections**: As this is an operator's guide rather than a wiring schematic, no wire colors or electrical connection points are shown beyond the physical mounting of the lever.

### **1. Kraftstoffverbrauchsanzeige (Fuel Consumption Indicator)**
*   **Description:** Explains that the instantaneous fuel consumption is displayed in liters per 100 kilometers (l/100 km) while driving.
*   **Operating Conditions:**
    *   During overrun fuel cutoff (deceleration) or when the engine is off, the needle drops to "0".
    *   At engine idle, the system displays maximum consumption.

### **2. Kraftstoffverbrauch (Fuel Consumption)**
*   **Information:** Notes that driving in very low temperatures, city traffic, short trips, trailer towing, or mountainous terrain increases fuel consumption.
*   **Additional Load:** Use of auxiliary equipment, such as air conditioning, slightly increases fuel consumption.
*   **Reference:** Refers to another page for specific fuel consumption data.

### **3. Kraftstoffreserve-Warnleuchten (Fuel Reserve Warning Lights)**
*   **Function:** When the ignition key is in position 2, the warning lights illuminate and should go out once the engine is running.
*   **Warning:** If the lights illuminate while the engine is running, the fuel reserve level has been reached.

### **4. Kühlmitteltemperatur-Anzeige (Coolant Temperature Display)**
*   **Specifications:** With the correct corrosion and antifreeze mixture, the coolant in the pressurized cooling system boils at approximately **130 °C**.
*   **Operating Range:** In high outdoor temperatures or during mountain driving, the coolant temperature may rise up to the red mark on the gauge.

### **5. Kühlmittelstand-Warnleuchte (Coolant Level Warning Light)**
*   **Function:** Like the fuel lights, it illuminates at ignition position 2 and should turn off when the engine starts.
*   **Warning:** If the light comes on while driving, the coolant level has dropped below the specified minimum.
*   **Action:** Refill coolant (referencing page 105). In cases of frequent or significant loss, the cause must be identified and repaired.

### **6. Hinweis (Note)**
*   **Technical Warning:** Do not continue driving without coolant in the cooling system. Overheating can lead to severe engine damage.

*   **Consumption unit:** l/100 km
*   **Coolant boiling point:** approx. 130 °C
*   **Ignition position:** Position 2
*   **Page References:** Mention of page 105 and another unspecified page for consumption data.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p94_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a German-language technical manual for a Mercedes-Benz (specifically page 92, likely for the R129 SL-Class based on the context). It contains instructional text regarding various instrument cluster warning lights and displays.

### **Components and Systems Mentioned**
*   **Washer Fluid Level Warning Light** (*Wasserstand-Kontrolleuchte*)
*   **Windshield Washer System** (*Scheibenwaschanlage*)
*   **Headlight Cleaning System** (*Scheinwerfer-Reinigungsanlage*)
*   **Bulb Failure Warning Light** (*Glühlampenausfall-Kontrolleuchte*)
*   **Exterior Temperature Display** (*Außentemperaturanzeige*)
*   **Temperature Sensor** (*Temperaturfühler*)
*   **Bulb Failure Monitor** (*Glühlampenkontrollgerät*)
*   **Ignition/Steering Lock** (*Lenkschloß*)
*   **Reservoir** (*Behälter*) for washer fluid
*   **Brake Lights** (*Bremsleuchten*) and **Turn Signals** (*Blinkleuchten*)
*   **Front Bumper** (*Stoßfänger*)
*   **Fuse** (*Sicherung*)

### **Connections and Logic**
*   **Lighting Retrofits:** The text specifies that additional lighting equipment must be connected to the **fuse located before the bulb failure monitor** to avoid malfunctions or damage to the monitor unit.
*   **Ignition Trigger:** Warning lights for washer fluid and bulb failure illuminate at **Key Position 2** and should extinguish once the engine is running.
*   **Bulb Failure Logic:**
    *   For exterior lights: The warning light stays on as long as the faulty light is switched on.
    *   For brake/turn signals: The warning light illuminates when the brake or signal is used and stays on until the engine is turned off.

### **Measurements and Values**
*   **Washer Fluid Threshold:** The warning light activates when the reservoir level drops to approximately **1/3 of the total volume**.
*   **Key Position:** Referenced as "**Schlüsselstellung 2**".
*   **Temperature Reference:** Mentions the **freezing point** (*Gefrierpunkt*) regarding road ice warnings.

### **References and Part Designations**
*   **Cleaning Concentrates:** Mentions Mercedes-Benz windshield washer concentrates **"S"** and **"W"**.
*   **Cross-references:** Directs the user to **Page 152** for the reservoir location and the **last page** (*letzte Seite*) for mixing ratios.
*   **Page Number:** **92** is printed at the bottom left.

### **Complete Text Transcription**

**Column 1:**
*   **Wasserstand-Kontrolleuchte Scheibenwaschanlage und Scheinwerfer-Reinigungsanlage** (Red Heading)
*   Bei Schlüsselstellung 2 im Lenk-schloß leuchtet die Kontrolleuchte und erlischt bei laufendem Motor.
*   Wenn die Kontrolleuchte bei lau-fendem Motor aufleuchtet, ist der Wasserstand auf ca. 1/3 des Behältervolumens abgesunken.
*   Bei nächster Gelegenheit Wasser mit MB Scheibenwaschmittel-Konzentrat „S“ und „W“ nachfül-len. Mischungsverhältnis siehe letzte Seite.
*   Der Behälter für Scheibenwasch-anlage und Scheinwerfer-Reini-gungsanlage befindet sich im Motorraum, siehe Seite 152.
*   Ist eine Glühlampe der Brems-leuchten oder der Blinkleuchten ausgefallen, leuchtet die Kontroll-leuchte beim Bremsen oder Blin-ken auf und erlischt erst wieder, wenn der Motor abgestellt wird. *(Note: This paragraph is a duplicate of text in the second column).*

**Column 2:**
*   **Glühlampenausfall-Kontrolleuchte** (Red Heading)
*   Bei Schlüsselstellung 2 im Lenk-schloß leuchtet die Kontrolleuchte schwach und erlischt bei laufen-dem Motor.
*   Wenn die Kontrolleuchte bei Schlüsselstellung 2 im Lenkschloß oder bei laufendem Motor hell aufleuchtet, wird eine defekte Glühlampe angezeigt.
*   Ist eine Glühlampe der Außen-beleuchtung ausgefallen, leuchtet die Kontrolleuchte, so lange die Außenbeleuchtung eingeschaltet ist.
*   Ist eine Brems- oder Blinkleuchte ausgefallen, leuchtet die Kontroll-leuchte beim Bremsen oder Blin-ken auf und erlischt erst wieder, wenn der Motor abgestellt wird.

**Column 3:**
*   **Hinweis:** (Red Heading)
*   Nachträglich angebrachte Be-leuchtungseinrichtungen müssen an der Sicherung vor dem Glüh-lampenkontrollgerät angeschlos-sen werden. Die Glühlampenaus-fallkontrolleuchte kann sonst ge-stört oder das Glühlampenkontroll-gerät beschädigt werden.
*   **Außentemperaturanzeige** (Red Heading)
*   Im Bereich des vorderen Stoß-fängers ist ein Temperaturfühler angebracht.
*   **Hinweis:** (Red Heading)
*   Auch wenn eine Temperatur über dem Gefrierpunkt angezeigt wird, ist dies keine Gewähr dafür, daß die Fahrbahn frei von jeglicher Eisbildung ist — besonders in Waldschneisen oder auf Brücken.

This image is a page from a German-language Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document, specifically page **93**. The section is titled "**Fahren**" (Driving), indicated by a vertical red tab on the right edge. The page describes the operation and meaning of three dashboard warning lights.

### Column 1: Überrollbügel-Warnleuchte (Roll Bar Warning Light)
*   **Function:** Indicates the status of the roll bar system.
*   **Normal Operation:** The light illuminates when the ignition key is in position 2 and should extinguish once the engine is running.
*   **Malfunction Indication:** If the light illuminates while the engine is running, the roll bar system is defective. Simultaneously, the control lights in the roll bar switch will flash.
*   **Instructions:** If a defect occurs, the user is instructed to manually raise the roll bar (referencing page 66) and have the system checked at a Mercedes-Benz service station.

### Column 2: Warnleuchte Sicherheitsgurte und Rückenlehnenverriegelung (Seat Belt and Backrest Locking Warning Light)
*   **Function:** Monitors both seat belt usage and the locking status of the seat backrests.
*   **Seat Belt Warning:** With the key in position 2, the light illuminates. After starting the engine, it flashes briefly to remind occupants to fasten their seat belts.
*   **Backrest Warning:** If the light does not go out after the initial flashing but remains lit, it indicates that a seat backrest is not properly locked. In this case, an audible warning tone sounds for approximately **20 seconds**.
*   **Correction:** The light will extinguish once the backrest is securely locked. If it remains lit while the backrest is engaged, the system requires service.

### Column 3: Bremsbelagverschleißanzeige (Brake Pad Wear Indicator)
*   **Function:** Monitors the thickness of the brake pads.
*   **Normal Operation:** The light illuminates with the key in position 2 and goes out when the engine runs.
*   **Wear Indication:** If the light illuminates during braking, it indicates that the front wheel brake pads are nearly worn out.
*   **ASR (Acceleration Slip Regulation) Note:** For vehicles equipped with ASR, this light indicates near-wear for both the front and rear brake pads.
*   **Instructions:** The brake system should be checked as soon as possible at a Mercedes-Benz service station.

### Technical Details Summary
*   **Component Names:** Überrollbügel (Roll bar), Lenkschloß (Steering lock), Motor (Engine), Schalter (Switch), Sicherheitsgurte (Seat belts), Rückenlehne (Backrest), Bremsbeläge (Brake pads), Vorderradbremse (Front wheel brake), Hinterradbremse (Rear wheel brake).
*   **Functional Connections:** All three systems are tied to "Schlüsselstellung 2" (Key position 2) for initial bulb checks and "laufendem Motor" (running engine) for operational status.
*   **Measurements:** Contains a time measurement of "**ca. 20 Sekunden**" (approx. 20 seconds) for the backrest warning tone.
*   **Part Numbers/Wire Colors:** None visible in this document snippet.

This image is a page from a German-language technical service or owner's manual for a Mercedes-Benz vehicle (specifically an R129 model, as indicated by the context). It describes the function and operation of the **Schneekettenschalter** (Snow Chain Switch) and the **Antriebs-Schlupf-Regelung (ASR)** system.

### Components and Indicators
*   **Schneekettenschalter (Snow Chain Switch):** A rocker switch pictured in an illustration at the top left.
    *   **Illustration Reference Number:** P42-2001-13 (located just below the switch image).
    *   **Kontrollleuchte im Schalter:** An internal control light that illuminates when the switch is active.
*   **Armaturanlage:** The dashboard or instrument panel where the switch is located.
*   **Kombi-Instrument (Instrument Cluster):** Contains two specific yellow indicators:
    *   **Gelbe Funktionsanzeige:** Yellow function indicator.
    *   **Gelbe ASR-Kontrollleuchte:** Yellow ASR control light.
*   **Bremsbelagverschleißanzeige:** Brake pad wear indicator, which monitors both front and rear brakes on ASR-equipped vehicles.

### Operational Parameters and Measurements
*   **Speed Thresholds for Snow Chain Switch:**
    *   Effective up to **40 km/h**.
    *   Remains active (stored in memory) up to **60 km/h**.
    *   Automatically reactivates when speed drops below **40 km/h**.
    *   Memory is cleared and light extinguished above **60 km/h**.
*   **System Malfunction State:** If the ASR light stays on while driving, engine power may be restricted to **2/3** of maximum output, and the accelerator pedal will require more force to depress.
*   **Ignition Key Positions:**
    *   **Stellung 2 (Position 2):** Used to check control lights; must be avoided during brake testing on a stand or when towing with a raised front axle.

### Key Instructions and Notes
*   **Operation:** Press the top of the rocker switch to activate; press the bottom to deactivate.
*   **Tires:** The spare wheel and all road wheels must be the same size for proper ASR function. Maximum winter effectiveness requires **M+S (Mud and Snow) radial tires**.
*   **ASR Malfunction:** If the ASR light illuminates while the engine is running, a fault is indicated, and the vehicle should be taken to a Mercedes-Benz service station.

### Visible Text Details
*   **Page Number:** 96 (bottom left).
*   **Main Headings:** "Schneekettenschalter", "Fahren mit Schneeketten", "Hinweise:".
*   **Body Text:** Detailed German instructions regarding the operation of the switch, speed limitations, ASR system self-tests, and towing precautions.

This image is page 97 from a Mercedes-Benz R129 technical manual, specifically documenting the **Niveauregulierung mit adaptivem Dämpfungs-System (ADS)** (Level control with adaptive damping system).

### Components and Visuals
*   **Damping adjustment switch (Dämpfungseinstellung):** An illustration of a rocker switch located in the center console. 
    *   The top portion of the switch features a shock absorber icon within a circular arrow symbol.
    *   There is an integrated indicator lamp (control light) below the icon.
*   **Figure Reference Number:** Beneath the switch illustration is the code **P32-0082-13**.
*   **Marginalia:** A vertical red bar on the right edge contains the word **"Fahren"** (Driving).

### Technical Text and Instructions (Translated from German)
The document provides several functional descriptions and operational instructions:

*   **System Function:** The lowest possible vehicle level is automatically adjusted based on switch position, increasing safety and reducing fuel consumption. Optimal damper hardness is automatically set according to the switch position, road surface, load, and driving style.
*   **Indicator Lamp Behavior:**
    *   When the ignition key is in position 2, the warning lamp lights up and should extinguish once the motor is running.
    *   If the lamp stays lit or comes on while driving, it indicates a low oil level in the reservoir or a system defect requiring professional service.
*   **Recalibration Note (Hinweis):** If the battery has been disconnected, the warning light will only extinguish after starting the engine and turning the steering wheel from lock to lock, then back to the center position.
*   **Switch Settings:**
    *   **Pressing Top:** Activates the "Hard" damping program for sporty driving. The indicator light in the switch will illuminate.
    *   **Pressing Bottom:** Activates the "Comfortable" damping program for general driving conditions.

### Additional Markings
*   **Page Number:** 97 is visible in the bottom right corner.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p100_img1.jpeg]
This image is a technical page (page 98) from a Mercedes-Benz R129 owner's manual or service document describing the **Fahrzeugniveau-Einstellung (Vehicle Level Adjustment)** system.

### Components
*   **Vehicle Level Adjustment Switch:** A rocker switch located near the main light switch.
    *   The upper part of the switch features an icon of a car with two upward arrows inside a circle, containing an integrated indicator light.
    *   The lower part features a small circular dot icon.
*   **Indicator Light:** Located within the top portion of the switch, it illuminates when the "Erhöhtes Niveau" (Raised Level) is active.

### Connections and Operation
*   **Top Press (Oben):** Activates "Erhöhtes Niveau" (Raised Level). The indicator light turns on.
*   **Bottom Press (Unten):** Activates "Normales Niveau" (Normal Level).

### Measurements and Technical Specifications
*   **Normal Level (Normales Niveau):** 
    *   Standard setting for general driving.
    *   Above **approx. 120 km/h**, the vehicle automatically lowers by **approx. 15 mm**.
*   **Raised Level (Erhöhtes Niveau):**
    *   Used for poor road conditions.
    *   Up to **approx. 50 km/h**, the level is increased by **approx. 30 mm** after a short drive.
    *   Between **approx. 50 km/h and 120 km/h**, the system automatically reverts to the normal vehicle level.
    *   At **approx. 120 km/h**, the system permanently switches back to the "Normal Level" setting, and the indicator light goes out.
    *   If the speed drops below **50 km/h**, the vehicle will only raise by **30 mm** again if the top of the switch is pressed manually once more.

### Part and Document Numbers
*   **Diagram Reference Code:** P32-0001-21A (visible below the switch illustration).
*   **Page Number:** 98

### Visible Text (German Transcription)
*   **Normales Niveau:** Einstellung für allgemeinen Fahrbetrieb. Über ca. 120 km/h wird das Fahrzeugniveau automatisch um ca. 15 mm abgesenkt.
*   **Erhöhtes Niveau:** Einstellung bei schlechten Strassenverhältnissen. Die Kontrollleuchte im Schalter leuchtet auf. Bis ca. 50 km/h wird das Fahrzeugniveau nach kurzer Fahrt um ca. 30 mm erhöht. Zwischen ca. 50 km/h und ca. 120 km/h stellt sich das normale Fahrzeugniveau ein. Bei ca. 120 km/h wird automatisch auf die Einstellung „Normales Niveau" umgeschaltet. Die Kontrollleuchte im Schalter erlischt. Unter ca. 50 km/h erfolgt eine Anhebung um ca. 30 mm erst dann, wenn der Schalter erneut oben gedrückt wird („Erhöhtes Niveau").
*   **Fahrzeugniveau-Einstellung:** Der Schalter befindet sich beim Lichtschalter. Schalter drücken: Oben = Erhöhtes Niveau. Die Kontrollleuchte im Schalter leuchtet auf. Unten = Normales Niveau.

This image is a page from a German Mercedes-Benz technical manual (likely for the R129 SL-Class) detailing the operation and safety warnings for the **Motorhaube** (engine hood/bonnet).

### Components and Labels
The diagram uses numerical callouts to identify specific parts:
*   **1 (Griff 1):** Interior hood release handle, located in the driver's side footwell near the pedals.
*   **2 (Griff 2):** Safety catch handle that emerges from the front radiator grille once the interior release is pulled.
*   **3 (Kanten 3):** The designated front edge areas of the hood where pressure should be applied to close it properly.

### Visual Illustrations
*   **Left Image:** Shows the interior driver-side footwell. The hood release lever is marked with a red "1". The accelerator pedal is visible to the right.
*   **Center Image:** Shows the front of the vehicle. A red arrow marked "2" indicates the safety handle popping out of the grille. Two red arrows marked "3" indicate where to press down on the hood.

### Instruction Text (Translated from German)
**Opening (Öffnen):**
1. Pull handle **(1)** to unlock the hood.
2. Handle **(2)** will pop out slightly from the radiator grille. If necessary, lift the hood slightly.
3. Pull handle **(2)** further out and open the hood. **Warning:** Do not lift the hood by handle (2).
4. Ensure the windshield wiper arm is not folded forward before opening.

**Closing (Schließen):**
1. Slam the hood shut, placing hands only on the edges marked **(3)**.
2. If the hood does not engage properly, open it again and slam it with more momentum.

**Warning (Achtung!):**
There is a risk of injury if the engine is running while the hood is open. The vehicle features an electronic ignition system with high voltage. It is dangerous to touch ignition components (coil, distributor, cables, spark plug connectors, or test sockets) under the following conditions:
*   While the engine is running.
*   While the engine is being started.
*   When the ignition key is in position 2 and the engine is being turned by hand.

### Additional Information
*   **Page Number:** 104
*   **Measurements/Part Numbers/Wire Colors:** None visible in this instructional diagram.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p107_img1.jpeg]
This technical diagram from a Mercedes-Benz R129 service manual details the procedure for checking and refilling the engine coolant.

### **Diagram Description**
The black-and-white illustration (labeled **P50-0001-813**) shows the engine's coolant expansion tank. A large red arrow points to the filler cap. On the side of the translucent tank, there is a numeric marking **"1"** indicating the cold-fill level. Several hoses are visible connected to the bottom and side of the unit.

### **Visible Components**
*   **Kühlmittelbehälter:** Coolant expansion tank.
*   **Deckel:** Filler cap (indicated by a red arrow).
*   **Einfüllstutzen:** Filler neck.
*   **Markierung 1:** Level indicator mark on the side of the reservoir.
*   **Connecting Hoses:** Various fluid lines connected to the reservoir.

### **Measurements and Technical Data**
*   **Coolant Temperature:** The reservoir should only be opened when the temperature is **under 90 °C**.
*   **Cold Fill Level:** Coolant should reach the ridge inside the filler neck, corresponding to **Marking 1** on the tank.
*   **Hot Fill Level:** When the coolant is hot, the level should be approximately **1.5 cm higher** than the cold mark.

### **Text Content (Translated from German)**

**Kühlmittelstand prüfen (Checking Coolant Level)**
*   Check the coolant level with the vehicle on level ground and the engine switched off.
*   The coolant level must reach:
    *   For cold coolant: up to the ridge in the filler neck (see also **Marking 1** on the tank).
    *   For hot coolant: approx. **1.5 cm higher**.
*   **Refilling coolant:** Only open the coolant reservoir when the coolant temperature is **under 90 °C**.

**Achtung! (Warning!)**
*   There is a risk of injury from hot coolant. Therefore, first turn the cap to the first notch to release excess pressure. Then continue turning the cap to remove it.

**Hinweis: (Note)**
*   For corrosion/antifreeze specifications, see "Operating fluids" (Betriebsstoffe), page 145.

**Additional Text:**
*   **Praktische Ratschläge:** Practical advice (vertical text on the right margin).
*   **105:** Page number.
*   **P50-0001-813:** Diagram reference number.

This image is page 106 from a German technical service manual for the Mercedes-Benz R129, specifically concerning the procedure for checking the engine oil level (**Motorölstand prüfen**).

The document is divided into three main sections corresponding to different engine models, each with an illustrative photograph and descriptive text.

### **Components and Labels**
In all three engine bay photographs, the following components are identified by red numbers:
1.  **Ölmeßstab** (Oil dipstick): Indicated by a red number '1'.
2.  **Öleinfüllöffnung** (Oil filler opening/cap): Indicated by a red number '2'.

### **Sections by Model**
*   **300 SL (Left Section):**
    *   **Image:** A black and white photograph of the 300 SL engine bay.
    *   **Image Reference:** In the bottom right corner of the photo is the code **P01-0001-B13**.
    *   **Text:** 
        *   **Motorölstand prüfen** (Check engine oil level - in red text)
        *   1 Ölmeßstab
        *   2 Öleinfüllöffnung

*   **300 SL-24 (Middle Section):**
    *   **Image:** A black and white photograph of the 300 SL-24 engine bay.
    *   **Image Reference:** In the bottom right corner of the photo is the code **P01-0004-B13**.
    *   **Text Instructions:**
        *   "Das Fahrzeug muß bei der Ölstandskontrolle waagerecht stehen." (The vehicle must be level during the oil level check.)
        *   "Ölstand ca. 5 Minuten nach dem Abstellen des betriebswarmen Motors kontrollieren." (Check the oil level approx. 5 minutes after switching off the engine at operating temperature.)
        *   "Vor jeder Kontrolle den Ölmeßstab abwischen." (Wipe the dipstick before every check.)

*   **500 SL (Right Section):**
    *   **Image:** A black and white photograph of the 500 SL engine bay.
    *   **Image Reference:** In the bottom right corner of the photo is the code **P01-0003-B13**.
    *   **Dipstick Diagram:** A small technical illustration shows the end of an oil dipstick with two red arrows pointing to the markers. The number **7378** is printed next to the bottom arrow.
    *   **Text Instructions:**
        *   "Der Ölstand muß zwischen der unteren Markierung (min) und der oberen Markierung (max) auf dem Ölmeßstab angezeigt werden." (The oil level must be shown between the lower marking (min) and the upper marking (max) on the dipstick.)
        *   "Zuviel eingefülltes Öl muß abgelassen oder abgesaugt werden." (Excess filled oil must be drained or suctioned off.)
        *   "Motorölstand-Warnleuchte siehe Seite 89." (Engine oil level warning light, see page 89.)

### **Additional Information**
*   **Page Number:** The number **106** is located at the bottom left of the document.
*   **Visual Elements:** The layout uses black and white photography and line drawings with red highlight indicators for clarity.

[Image: r129_betriebsanleitung_1991_1993_de_p109_img1.jpeg]
This image is a page from a German Mercedes-Benz R129 service or owner's manual (page 107), specifically detailing how to check the automatic transmission oil level for the **300 SL**, **300 SL-24**, and **500 SL** models.

### **Components and Diagrams**
The page features two black-and-white technical photographs:
*   **Left Image (labeled 300 SL, 300 SL-24):** Shows the engine compartment of a 6-cylinder model. The transmission oil dipstick is located at the rear of the engine. A red-highlighted locking lever is shown with arrows.
    *   **Diagram Number:** P27-0031-13
*   **Right Image (labeled 500 SL):** Shows the engine compartment of a V8 model, identifiable by the large "MERCEDES" text on the intake manifold. The transmission dipstick is located near the firewall.
    *   **Diagram Number:** P27-2002-113

### **Legend and Key**
Both diagrams use the same numbering system for the **Ölmeßstab-Verschlußhebel** (Dipstick locking lever):
*   **1 (Red arrow pointing up/counter-clockwise):** **lösen** (release)
*   **2 (Red arrow pointing down/clockwise):** **feststellen** (lock/secure)

### **Text Transcription**

**Section Title:** 
Ölstand im automatischen Getriebe prüfen (Checking the oil level in the automatic transmission)

**Left/Center Column Text (specific to 500 SL):**
"Ölstand prüfen, wenn Ölverlust festgestellt wird oder wenn Schaltstörungen auftreten. Der Ölstand sollte dann in einer Mercedes-Benz Service-Station richtiggestellt werden. 

Ölstand nur bei betriebswarmem Getriebe und waagerecht stehendem Fahrzeug prüfen. Dazu den Motor laufen lassen, das Getriebe in Stellung „P“ schalten und die Feststellbremse betätigen."

**(Translation summary:** Check oil level if loss is detected or shifting issues occur. Correct at a service station. Check only when the transmission is at operating temperature and the car is level, with the engine running in "P" and parking brake applied.)

**Right Column Text (General Procedure):**
"Verschlußhebel lösen (1) und Ölmeßstab herausziehen. Meßstab mit einem fusselfreien Tuch abwischen und zum Messen ganz einstecken. Meßstab herausziehen und Ölstand ablesen – er soll zwischen der Min- und Max-Marke liegen. 

Abschließend den Meßstab ganz einstecken und mit dem Verschlußhebel sichern (2).

**Hinweise:** 
Die Betriebstemperatur ist nach **ca. 10 km** Fahrt erreicht. 

Bei abgekühltem Getriebe wird ein geringerer Ölstand angezeigt – auf keinen Fall Öl nachfüllen. 

Die Max-Marke darf nicht überschritten werden. Eventuell zuviel eingefülltes Öl muß abgelassen oder abgesaugt werden. 

Füllmenge siehe „Betriebsstoffe“, Seite 142."

**(Translation summary:** Release lever (1), pull dipstick, wipe with lint-free cloth, re-insert fully. Read level (must be between Min/Max). Re-insert and lock (2). Notes: Operating temp reached after ~10km. Do not top up when cold. Do not exceed Max mark. Refer to page 142 for fill quantities.)

### **Additional Page Elements**
*   **Page Number:** 107 (bottom right)
*   **Vertical Margin Text (right side):** Praktische Ratschläge (Practical Tips)
*   **Color Block:** There is a solid red square/rectangle in the right margin.
